billy was very happy. today he was going to mail a great letter to his friend. he walked up to the gate of the post office and waved his letter. he was so excited for his friend to get it. suddenly, the wind blew hard and the gate of the post office opened wide. before billy knew what was happening, the letter flew out of his hands and the gate slammed shut. billy waited for a few minutes by the gate, but the letter never came back. he knew it was gone forever. he slowly walked away, feeling very sad. he would never get to share great news with his friend.

once upon a time, there was a rare otter. he lived in a big river. the otter had many friends, like fish and ducks. they all liked to play in the water. one day, the otter saw his friends were sad. they were hungry, but there was no food. the otter wanted to help, so he went to find food for them. the otter swam and swam. he found food to supply his friends. he brought back a lot of fish for everyone. they all ate and were very happy. the rare otter and his friends played in the water and had a great day.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim had a toy called scale. scale was a small, green dinosaur. they played together every day. one day, tim and scale went to the store with mom. tim saw a big, sweet cake. he wanted the cake, but mom said no. tim was sad, but he did not get the cake. he did not want to be a spoiled boy. tim and scale went home and played in the yard. they had fun and forgot about the cake. tim learned that it was okay not to get everything he wanted. he was happy with his toy, scale, and being a good boy.

once upon a time, there was a big gray cat. the cat liked to play in the kitchen. one day, the cat found a pan. the pan was very big and shiny. the cat wanted to play with the pan. the cat put the pan on the floor. then, the cat jumped into the pan. the cat liked the sound it made. the cat played in the pan all day. the cat was very happy. at night, the cat was tired. the cat put the pan back in the kitchen. the cat went to sleep. the cat had a good day playing with the pan. the cat dreamed of playing with the pan again tomorrow.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named sally. she had a big green friend named broccoli. they liked to play games and have fun. one day, sally and broccoli played a game called "guess". sally would close her eyes and broccoli would hide. then, sally would try to find him. broccoli was very good at hiding, so sally had to be patient to find him. finally, sally found broccoli hiding behind a big tree. they both laughed and clapped their hands. they played the "guess" game all day long and had so much fun. and sally learned that being patient made the game even better.

one day, a beautiful girl went to a big park. she saw many kids playing. she wanted to play too. she saw a ball and she wanted to pass the ball to the kids. she took the ball and passed it to a boy. the boy passed it back. they played with the ball in rhythm. they laughed and had fun. the girl was happy. then, something unexpected happened. a big dog came and took the ball. the dog ran away with the ball. the girl and the boy were sad. they could not play anymore. the beautiful day was not fun anymore.

once there was a silly elephant. the elephant wanted to show everyone how special he was, and he had a goal to do something incredible. he looked around his environment and saw some butterflies displaying their beautiful wings in the sky. this gave the elephant an idea! he decided to display his big ears to the entire world. he waved them around and all his friends laughed. the elephant smiled and kept displaying them, feeling silly and proud at the same time. he was so happy that he achieved his goal and that everyone could see him being silly.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim wanted to go to the shop with his mom. he was very excited to buy a new toy. when they got to the shop, tim saw a big dog. tim was scared of the dog. his mom held his hand and told him not to be scared. the dog was nice and just wanted to play. tim and his mom went inside the shop. they found a toy tim wanted. they bought the toy and went home. tim was not scared anymore. he played with his new toy and was very happy.

once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a little rabbit and a tiny turtle. they were good friends. one day, they found a patch of yummy carrots. they both loved carrots so much. the little rabbit and the tiny turtle decided to see who could eat the most carrots. they became competitive. they ate and ate and ate. they did not know when to stop. soon, the rabbit and the turtle felt sick. they had eaten too many carrots. they learned that being too competitive was not good. they promised to share and not be greedy again. from that day on, they always shared and played together happily.

once upon a time there was a young boy named john. he loved to explore in his bright red jeep. one day, while he was out adventuring, john noticed something terrible. a group of bullies had taken control of a nearby playground. john was scared, so he decided to go home. on his way, he ran into his mom. john said to her, "mommy, there's been terrible trouble in the playground!" his mom nodded and said, "don't worry john, i'll send help right away." soon, the bullies were chased away by a police jeep and the playground was safe again! john was relieved and continued exploring with a smile.

once upon a time, there was a girl named sue. sue liked to work with her mom. one day, they found a big crystal in their yard. the crystal was very pretty. sue and her mom were very happy. sue showed the crystal to her friend, tim. tim said, "that is a boring crystal." sue was sad. she didn't want her crystal to be boring. she wanted it to be fun. that night, sue and her mom heard a noise. they went to look at the crystal. the crystal was not boring anymore. it was shining and making fun colors. sue and her mom danced and played with the fun crystal. they were very happy.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she loved to dance. one day, she wore her pretty black dress to dance in the park. in the park, she met a boy named tim. tim was not nice. he said, "you can't dance in that black dress. it's too harsh!" lily felt sad, but she wanted to dance. lily said, "i can dance if i want to!" she started to dance in her black dress. tim saw her dance and thought it was fun. he said, "i'm sorry, lily. can i dance with you?" they both danced and became friends.

one day, a little girl named lucy found a puzzle on the floor. it was a big puzzle with wide, colorful pieces. she wanted to put the puzzle together, but she didn't know how. lucy's big brother tom saw her frown. he asked, "why are you sad, lucy?" lucy said, "i want to do the puzzle, but i don't know how." tom smiled and said, "i can help you!" together, lucy and tom put the puzzle together. they matched the colors and shapes until the puzzle was done. it was a picture of a happy sun and a blue sky. lucy was so happy, and she hugged tom. they both smiled and played with the puzzle all day.

once upon a time, there was a lovely raven. the raven had many friends in the forest. they would play all day and have fun together. one day, the raven wanted to do something new. he wanted to sing a song for his friends. he practiced and practiced until he felt ready. when the day came, the raven started to sing. but he forgot the words! he felt embarrass. his friends just smiled and said, "it's okay, raven. we still love you." the raven felt happy and played with his friends again.

one day, a little girl named amy went to her friend tom's house. tom had a great big piano. amy had never seen a piano before. she wanted to touch it and see what it could do. "can i touch your piano, tom?" amy asked. tom said, "yes, amy. you can touch it. let's make music together!" they were very happy to play the piano. amy touched the white keys and tom touched the black keys. they made pretty sounds. they laughed and played for a long time. the piano made them feel so good. they knew they would play the piano again soon, and have more fun together.

once upon a time, there was a hairy dog named bob. bob liked to cook. he had a big pot and a big spoon. one day, he found a motor in the yard. he thought it was a toy. bob wanted to cook with the motor. he put it in his big pot. he added water, salt, and some bones. he stirred the pot with his big spoon. the motor started to get very hot. bob didn't know that motors can be dangerous. the motor got hotter and hotter. suddenly, the pot broke, and the hot water spilled everywhere. poor bob got hurt and cried. his cooking adventure had a bad ending.

once upon a time, there was a good cow named molly. molly lived on a farm with her friends. they liked to play in the big field every day. one day, molly and her friends were playing when something happened. a big wind came and blew their ball far away. they all looked at each other and decided to find the ball. molly and her friends walked and walked until they found the ball near a big tree. they were so happy! they played with the ball again and had a great day. molly and her friends knew that if they worked together, good things would happen.

once upon a time, there was a beautiful room. it was full of toys and colors. in this room lived a little girl named lily and her best friend, a cat named fuzz. one day, lily and fuzz wanted to play a game. they had to trust each other to find the best hiding spot. lily closed her eyes and counted while fuzz ran to hide. lily looked in the beautiful room and found fuzz under the bed. they both laughed and played more games. they knew they could trust each other and had lots of fun in the beautiful room.

once upon a time, there was a powerful ant. this ant was very strong and could carry big things. one day, the ant found a bean. the bean was green and small. the powerful ant wanted to carry the bean back to its home. so, the ant picked up the bean with its strong legs. it walked and walked, carrying the bean on its back. finally, the ant reached its home. all the other ants were happy to see the bean. they all ate the bean together, and they became powerful ants too. they were strong and could carry many things. and they all lived happily together.

once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a powerful ant. the ant had a big shield. he liked to dance. one sunny day, the ant met a bee. the bee said, "hello, ant! i like your shield. can you show me how you dance?" the ant smiled and said, "of course, bee! let's dance together." so, the powerful ant and the bee danced and danced. they danced near the trees and near the flowers. they had lots of fun. they became good friends. and from that day on, they always danced together with the big shield.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim had a toy box full of fun toys. one day, he wanted to fit all his toys in the box, but it was too full. tim was upset. that night, there was a big storm. tim saw the lightning outside his window. the lightning was bright and made loud noises. tim was scared, but he had an idea. he took his toys out of the box and put them on the floor. then, he hid under the box like a turtle. the box fit over him just right. now, tim was not upset anymore. he felt safe from the lightning under his toy box.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named ella. she was a fearful girl who was scared of many things. one day, ella was walking in the park with her mom. ella's mom said, "ella, look! there is a man giving away chocolate. do you want some?" ella was scared but she loved chocolate. she said, "yes, mommy. i want chocolate, please." ella's mom held her hand and they walked to the man. ella received the chocolate from the man. she said, "thank you." ella was happy to have the chocolate and she was not scared anymore. they went home and ella shared the chocolate with her family.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lucy. she loved to play with her toys in her room. one day, she wanted to invite her friends to play with her. lucy invited her friends, tom and sally, to her room. they played with her toys and had a lot of fun. they laughed and played with blocks, dolls, and cars. after a while, they found a dead bug on the floor. they were surprised, but they did not touch it. lucy's mom came in and took the bug away. then, they continued to play and have fun in lucy's room.

once upon a time, there was a big red train. today, the train was going to arrive at a new town. the town had many happy people. they were so excited to see the big red train. in the town, there was a little boy named tim. tim was very happy to see the train. he told his mom, "look, mom! the big red train is here!" his mom smiled and said, "yes, it is, tim. let's go see it together." tim and his mom went to the train station. they saw the big red train arrive. tim clapped and jumped up and down. the happy people in the town cheered. they all had a great day with the big red train.

one day, a girl named lily went for a walk. she liked to skip and hop. the sun was bright in the sky. lily was happy. lily saw a big gate. she went to the gate and pushed it open. behind the gate, there were many pretty flowers. lily skipped in the garden and picked some flowers. suddenly, a big dog came out. the dog could talk! "hi, lily!" said the dog. lily was surprised. they became friends and played in the garden together.

once upon a time, there was a little gray bird. the bird had a perfect nest in a big tree. the bird loved the tree because it was a safe place to live. one day, the bird saw a big red ball arrive near the tree. the bird was very happy to see the red ball. the bird flew down to play with the red ball. the bird pushed the ball with its beak and had a lot of fun. after a while, the bird went back to its perfect nest in the big tree. the bird was tired but happy. the bird looked at the red ball and knew it had a new friend. the bird fell asleep and had sweet dreams.

once upon a time, there was a model. she was pretty and she always smiled. but this model was fake! everyone could tell because her smile didn't look real. one day she wanted to try to reverse it. she practiced and practiced but it didn't work. she kept trying but it didn't help. then, one day something strange happened. her smile suddenly reversed! she was so happy and everyone was shocked. from then on, her smile was always real.

one day, a little girl named sally had a heavy bag. she did not want to suffer with the heavy bag. she had an idea to make it better. sally's idea was to ask her friend, tom, to help. tom was strong and could carry the heavy bag. sally asked tom, and he said yes. they both carried the heavy bag together. now, sally did not suffer with the heavy bag. her idea was good. sally and tom were happy friends. they played together and had fun with the bag not being heavy anymore.

once upon a time, there was a boy. the boy liked to be organized. he put his toys in a big box. he always knew where to find them. his room was very clean. one day, the boy could not find his favorite toy. he said, "mom, i can't find my toy!" his mom said, "look in your big box." the boy looked, but it was not there. he felt sad. then, his little sister came in. she said, "i have a surprise!" she opened her hand and there was the toy! the boy was so happy. he said, "thank you, sister!" from that day on, they played together with their toys.

once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a police named tom. tom was very modest and kind. he loved to help people and make them happy. one day, tom decided to decorate the police station. he wanted to make it look nice for everyone who came there. he used colorful papers and drew fun pictures on them. he put the papers on the walls to make them pretty. the people in the town saw the decorated police station and smiled. they liked how tom made the place look happy. tom felt proud and glad that he could make others happy too. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a big blue cat. the cat loved to play outside. one day, the cat went out to play in the wind. the wind was strong and fun. the cat ran, jumped, and played all day long. as the sun went down, the cat began to yawn. the cat was very tired from playing in the wind. the cat wanted to go home and rest. the cat walked back to his cozy little house. when the cat got home, he laid down on his soft bed. the cat closed his eyes and listened to the wind outside. soon, the big blue cat fell asleep, dreaming of more fun days playing in the wind.

once upon a time, there was a beautiful bird. the bird lived in a big world with many trees and flowers. one day, the bird saw a little boy. the little boy looked sad. the bird asked the little boy, "why are you sad?" the little boy said, "i did something bad and now i feel embarrass." the bird wanted to help the little boy feel better. the bird said, "let's play a game. that will make you happy!" the little boy agreed. they played and played, but the little boy still felt embarrass. the bird tried to help, but it was not enough. the little boy stayed sad and the bird felt sad too. the end.

once upon a time, there was a green fisherman named bob. bob loved to catch fish in the big blue sea. every day, he would go out on his little boat and wait for the fish to swim by. one sunny day, while bob was waiting, a funny fish swam up to him. the fish liked to joke and make bob laugh. the fish would wiggle and dance in the water, and bob would giggle and clap his hands. after a while, the green fisherman and the funny fish became good friends. they played and joked together all day long. and from that day on, bob always had fun when he went fishing.

one day, a little insect went for a walk. he liked to march, so he marched all day. as he marched, he met a big, frightened cat. "why are you frightened, big cat?" asked the little insect. "i saw a big dog, and it scared me," said the frightened cat. the little insect wanted to help the big cat. so, they marched together. they marched and marched until they found a safe place to hide. the big cat was not frightened anymore. "thank you, little insect," said the big cat. "you are very brave." the little insect smiled and they both marched back home, happy and safe.

once upon a time, in a big town, there was a famous gate. the gate was big and pretty. many people came to see the gate and take pictures. the gate was happy to be famous. one day, a little girl named lucy came to the famous gate. she looked at the gate and thought it was very nice. lucy wanted to show the gate that she liked it, so she gave the gate a little kiss. the gate felt very happy that lucy had kissed it. from that day on, more and more people came to see the famous gate and give it a little kiss too. the gate and the people in the town lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a very attractive cat named fluffy. fluffy loved to nap all day long. she found a quiet spot under a big tree to sleep. one day, while fluffy was napping, something unexpected happened. a small bird came and sat on the branch above fluffy. the bird was singing a happy song. fluffy woke up and saw the bird. fluffy decided to be friends with the bird instead of chasing it away. they played together and had lots of fun. from that day on, fluffy and the bird were best friends, and they shared the quiet spot under the big tree.

once there was a square. the square was very independent. it liked to do things by itself. one day, the square decided it wanted to explore. so it left to find something new. but after a while, it got lost. the square began to worry. it looked for someone or something to help it. but it couldn't find anyone or anything. so it sighed sadly and realized it was all alone. it was stuck in the wilderness forever. the end.

one day, a little boy named tim went for a walk. he saw a big tree with lots of leaves. tim thought the tree was very interesting. he wanted to play near the tree. as tim played, he saw a small leak coming from the tree. the water made a tiny stream on the ground. tim was curious about the leak. he put his finger in the water and felt it was cold. tim's friend, sam, came to play too. sam saw the leak and said, "look, tim! the tree is leaking water!" tim replied, "yes, it's very interesting!" they both played near the leak and had a fun day.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named mia. mia loved to get mail. one day, mia saw an envelope in her mailbox. she was very happy. mia opened the envelope and found a sour candy inside. she wanted to eat the candy, but her mom said, "you must share with your friend, sam." mia did not want to share, but she listened to her mom. when mia gave sam the sour candy, sam smiled and said, "thank you!" sam then gave mia a big, sweet candy. mia was so surprised! she learned that sharing can bring even more happiness.

once upon a time, there was a fast car named speedy. he loved to speed down the road, going faster and faster. one day, while speeding, speedy saw a big truck with a hook on the back. the truck was slow and old. speedy said, "hey, truck! why do you have a hook?" the truck replied, "i use my hook to help cars that are stuck or broken. i am very strong." speedy felt ashamed because he thought only fast cars were good. he realized that the truck with the hook was helpful too. from that day on, speedy and the truck became friends, and they helped each other on the road.

once upon a time, there was a big room with lots of furniture. there was a normal chair, a normal table, and a normal bed. in this room, there lived a little girl named lily. one day, lily wanted to play a game. she decided to lock all the furniture in the room. she locked the chair, the table, and the bed. she felt very happy and proud of her game. then, lily's mom came into the room. she saw the locked furniture and asked lily what she did. lily told her mom about her game. her mom smiled and helped lily unlock the furniture. they had a fun time playing together in the room.

once upon a time, there was a deep blue blouse. the blouse lived in a box. one day, the blouse wanted to turn into a pretty dress. but it did not know how. a little girl named sue found the box. sue loved the deep blue blouse. she wore it and went to play. the blouse was happy but still wanted to turn into a pretty dress. then, a magic bird saw sue and the blouse. the bird knew how to help. it sang a song and the blouse turned into a pretty dress! sue was so happy and surprised. the deep blue dress was now the most beautiful dress she had ever seen.

once upon a time there was a brave fish. he liked to swim in the sea. one day, the fish noticed something rare in the ocean. it was a special kind of print. the fish wanted to get it. but the print was surrounded by a big, dangerous shark. the fish knew it had to be brave and fight the shark. with courage and bravery, the fish swam towards the shark. the shark was so surprised, it quickly swam away! the brave fish got the print! it was very special and rare. he was so happy and proud of himself for being brave. the fish swam away with the rare print and never forgot his bravery!

one day, a pretty girl named sue went to the park. she saw a big dinosaur. the dinosaur was sad. sue wanted to help the dinosaur. sue observed the dinosaur. she saw that the dinosaur was hungry. sue had an idea. she went to find food for the dinosaur. sue found apples and gave them to the dinosaur. the dinosaur ate the apples and was happy. sue and the dinosaur became friends. they played in the park every day.

once upon a time, there was a big castle. a little girl named lily lived near the castle. she loved to play near it every day. one day, while she was playing, something magic happened. a fairy appeared! the fairy said, "lily, i can make you glad. i will give you a big surprise." lily was very excited. she could not wait to see what the fairy would do. the fairy waved her wand and suddenly, the big castle turned into a giant cake! lily could not believe her eyes. she was so glad and started to eat the yummy cake. the fairy laughed and said, "enjoy your sweet surprise, lily!"

once upon a time, there was a girl called jane. she loved playing with blocks. one day, jane was playing with her blocks like she always did. suddenly, something unusual happened. the blocks started to move! the blocks began to spin and move around in different shapes. jane could not believe it! she watched as the blocks became something new. they had become a big tower. the tower was so tall that it almost touched the sky. jane was so excited. she smiled and she knew that the tower was something special and very unusual.

once upon a time, there was a small, clean cabin in the woods. a nice family lived in the cabin. there was a mom, a dad, and a little girl named lily. one day, lily wanted to help her mom get some food. they walked to the store and got apples, bananas, and cookies. lily was very happy to help her mom. after they got home, lily helped her mom put the food away in the cabin. then they all sat down to eat a yummy snack. the family was happy in their clean cabin, and lily felt proud to help.

once upon a time, there was a young boy named tim. tim loved to play with his red scooter. he would ride it up and down the street all day. one sunny day, tim saw a big ball stuck in a tree. he wanted to reach it so he could play with it. tim had a smart idea. he thought he could use his scooter to help him reach the ball. he put his scooter next to the tree and climbed on it. tim stretched his arm to reach the ball. but then, the scooter moved and tim fell down. tim was sad and hurt. he could not play with the big ball or his scooter anymore.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim loved to go on walks with his mom. one day, they went for a walk and discovered a huge park. in the park, they saw a vendor. the vendor was selling yummy treats. tim's mom asked, "would you like an ice cream, tim?" tim smiled and said, "yes, please, mom!" tim and his mom enjoyed their ice creams as they walked around the huge park. they played on the swings and slides. they had a great day together, and tim couldn't wait to come back to the park again.

once upon a time, there was a normal car. the car had a big smile on it. the car liked to speed fast on the road. it loved to go vroom vroom. one day, the car went to the park. the car saw other cars there. they all had smiles too. they wanted to play with the normal car. they all raced together. the normal car was very happy. but then, the normal car went too fast. it did not see the big tree. the car went crash into the tree. the smile on the car was gone. the normal car was sad and broken. and that was the end of the normal car's fun day.

once upon a time, there was a graceful cat. this cat lived in a big forest. the cat liked to play with its friends. one day, the cat saw a spear. the cat did not recognize the spear. the spear was long and sharp. the cat was scared of the spear. the cat told its friends about the spear. they all went to look at it. they were all scared too. in the end, they left the spear alone and went to play again. they were happy and safe.

once upon a time, there was a man. the man liked to lie. he would tell lies to his friends, and he felt ashamed. one day, the man met a dog. the dog was sad. the man lied to the dog and said he had a big bone. the dog was happy, but the man felt ashamed. the man decided to stop lying. he told the truth to the dog and gave him a real bone. the dog was happy, and the man was not ashamed anymore. they became best friends and lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a sleepy cat named tom. tom lived in a small house with a fence. the fence was white and pretty. tom liked to sleep near the fence. one day, tom saw a ball outside the fence. he wanted to play with the ball. but tom was too sleepy to jump over the fence. tom needed help to get the ball. tom's friend, a dog named max, came to help. max was not sleepy. max jumped over the fence and got the ball for tom. tom and max played with the ball all day. after playing, they both became sleepy and slept near the fence. they were happy friends.

once upon a time, there was a dog named spot. spot was an obedient dog. he always did what his owner, a little boy named tim, told him to do. one day, tim and spot went to the park. tim put a chain on spot so he would not run away. they played all day and had lots of fun. while they were playing, they saw a big pumpkin that had started to rot. "ew!" said tim. "that pumpkin is old and yucky." spot barked at the pumpkin. they left the pumpkin and went home, happy after their fun day at the park.

once upon a time, there was a lovely little girl named lily. she had a toy bear named ben. one day, ben got sick. lily wanted to help her friend feel better. lily's mom said, "let's give ben some medicine to make him well." lily agreed and gave ben the medicine. she told ben, "this will work and make you feel good." ben smiled and took the medicine. after a short nap, ben felt better. the medicine worked! lily and ben played all day. they were happy and had lots of fun together.

once upon a time, there was a happy rabbit named bob. bob loved to eat celery. one day, he set out to find the biggest celery in the world. bob was very enthusiastic about his adventure. bob hopped and hopped until he found a big garden. in the garden, he saw the biggest celery ever! it was taller than him! bob was so excited that he jumped up and down. bob ate the big celery and felt so happy. he went back to his home and told all his friends about his adventure. they all laughed and cheered. from that day on, bob was known as the rabbit who found the biggest celery in the world.

once upon a time, there was a big, bossy cat named tom. tom liked to ride on a little red bike. he rode it up and down the street every day. the other animals watched him and thought he was very funny. one day, tom saw a leak in his bike tire. he was sad because he could not ride his bike anymore. his friend, a small dog named sam, saw tom's sad face and wanted to help. sam was very smart and knew how to fix the leak. he helped tom fix the bike tire, and they became good friends. now, tom was not so bossy anymore, and they both rode their bikes together, having fun and laughing all day long.

once upon a time, there was a girl named sue. sue loved to touch things. one day, she saw a box of matches. she wanted to touch them too. sue touched the match, and it made a fire. she was scared. she did not know what to do. then, a lemon came rolling by. the lemon was sour, but it was also magic. the magic lemon saw the fire and knew it could help. it jumped into the fire, and the fire went out. sue was so happy. she hugged the lemon and said thank you. from that day on, sue and the magic lemon were the best of friends.

once upon a time, there was a little, quiet mouse. the mouse lived in a small house. one day, the mouse wanted to enter a big house to find some food. as the mouse entered the big house, he saw a big cat. the cat saw the mouse and said, "hello, little mouse. what are you doing here?" the mouse was scared but said, "i am looking for some food." the cat was nice and helped the quiet mouse find food. they became good friends and played together. the mouse was happy he entered the big house and met a new friend.

once upon a time, there was a sailor. he lived near the big blue sea. the sailor had a small boat with a fair sail. he loved to sail on the water every day. one day, the sailor found a big box. he wanted to open it. but first, he needed to wrap it with his strong rope. the sailor wrapped the big box with the rope very tight. the sailor took the big box to his boat. he sailed away with the wind. the fair sail helped him go fast. the sailor was very happy. he had a fun day sailing with his big box.

one day, a polite dog and a big rock were in a race. the dog was fast and the rock could not move. the dog wanted to win the race. the rock felt sad because it could not win. then, something unexpected happened. a strong wind blew and pushed the rock. the rock started to move very fast. it went faster and faster. the dog was surprised to see the rock moving. at the end of the race, the rock and the dog crossed the line at the same time. they both won the race. the dog was happy and the rock was happy too. they became best friends and played together every day.

once upon a time, there was a little girl. her name was sue. sue had an adorable cat. the cat's name was tom. sue and tom liked to play together. one day, sue found a map. the map showed the way to a big park. sue and tom wanted to go to the park. they walked and walked, following the map. at the park, there were many kids and animals. sue and tom played for a long time. they were very happy. but then, it got dark. sue and tom could not find their way home. they were sad and scared.

one day, tom and sue had a race. they wanted to see who could paint the best. tom painted a big, thick tree. sue painted a pretty sun. they both worked very hard. but, a big wind came. it blew their paint all over. tom's tree was not thick anymore. sue's sun was not pretty anymore. they were both very sad. tom and sue had a big hug. they knew they could fix it. they painted together. the tree and sun looked better than before. they were both happy and won the race together.

once upon a time, there was a young boy named tim. tim loved to eat jam. he would eat it on bread every day. one day, tim's mom told him that they had no more jam. tim was sad. tim decided to go to the store to buy more jam. on his way, he met a nice lady. she asked, "why do you look so sad, young boy?" tim told her about the jam. the lady said, "i can provide you some jam." the lady gave tim a big jar of jam. tim was very happy. he thanked the lady and went home. tim's mom was happy too. they ate jam on bread together and smiled.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim was a confused boy. he did not mind helping his mom and dad. he liked to be a good boy. one day, tim went for a walk. he saw a well. the well was very deep. tim wanted to look inside the well. he was careful not to fall in. he knew he had to mind his steps. tim heard a small sound from the well. he looked inside and saw a little bird. the bird was scared. tim helped the bird out of the well. the bird was happy. tim went home and told his mom and dad. they were proud of him for being kind and minding the well.

once upon a time, in a big tree, there was a smart dove. the smart dove had many friends. they would play together all day. one day, the smart dove and her friends went for a walk. they walked through the green grass and saw many pretty flowers. they walked and walked, having fun and laughing. as they walked, they met a new friend. the new friend was a little bird. the smart dove and her friends played with the little bird. they all had a great time. and from that day on, they always walked and played together.

once upon a time, there was a gray cat. the cat liked to watch the town. every day, the cat sat on a hill and watched the town below. one day, while the cat was watching, it saw a big red ball. the red ball was rolling down the street. the cat was surprised. it had never seen a big red ball in the town before. the cat ran down the hill to see the big red ball up close. but when the cat got close to the ball, it saw that it was not a ball at all! it was a big, round, red house. the cat was very happy to find a new friend, the red house, in the gray town.

once upon a time, there was a big red button. it was in an open room where everyone could see it. the button was there to prevent something bad from happening. one day, a little boy named tim saw the button. he wanted to touch it, but his mom said no. tim did not listen to his mom. he thought it would be fun to push the button. this caused a big conflict between tim and his mom. in the end, tim pushed the button. the bad thing happened. everyone was sad and upset. the moral of the story is to always listen to your mom and dad. they know what is best for you.

one day, a boy named tim had a knot in his shoe. he tried to untie it, but it was too hard. he asked his mom for help. his mom said, "tim, you need to learn how to untie your knot by yourself." tim went outside to play. he saw his friend, sam. sam was rude to tim. sam said, "i can untie my knot, but you can't." tim was sad. then, a big dog came and played with them. the dog was very good at untying knots. the dog untied tim's knot, and tim was happy. sam was surprised. tim said, "see, i don't need your help. the dog can help me." sam was not rude anymore, and they all played together.

one day, a little boy named tim went to search for a toy. he looked in his room, which was not very organized. there were toys everywhere! tim could not find his toy drum. then, he heard a rhythm coming from the living room. tim walked to the living room and saw his dad playing the drum. the rhythm was nice and made tim happy. tim asked his dad if he could play the drum too. his dad said yes and they played the drum together. they made a fun rhythm and danced. then, they organized tim's room, so he could always find his drum.

once upon a time, there was a girl named sue. sue had an unusual purse. it was big and round. she liked to put many things in it. one day, sue saw a sack. the sack was on the ground. she wanted to see what was inside. sue opened the sack. inside, there were many colorful balls. sue was very happy. sue put the balls in her unusual purse. she took them home. sue played with the balls all day. she had so much fun. sue loved her unusual purse and the sack of colorful balls.

once upon a time, in a big tree, there was a little bird. the bird had a friend, a small bug. the bug had a long rod. they liked to play together. one day, the bird said, "i want to fly high and see the world." the bug said, "i want to come too. my rod can help us." the bird thought it was an important idea. the bird and the bug used the rod to fly high in the sky. they saw many things like trees, houses, and kids playing. they were happy and had a fun adventure together.

once upon a time, there was a lively caterpillar. everyday it would mail presents to its family and friends. it was the happiest caterpillar alive. one day it was mailing a special present to a cousin. on its way, the lively caterpillar found a sweet flower and couldn't resist taking a bite. suddenly, the caterpillar felt sleepy and could no longer deliver the present. the caterpillar's family and friends waited and waited, but the present never arrived. the moral of this story is that it is important to be responsible. we must not be tempted by the things we find while doing our job.

one day, a little bee went out to find food. it saw a long flower with sweet stuff inside. the bee went to the flower and started to eat. soon, the bee felt very heavy. it could not fly. "why do i weigh so much?" the bee asked a nearby bug. the bug said, "you ate too much! now you are too heavy to fly." the bee was sad and did not know what to do. but then, a strong wind came and blew the bee up into the air. the wind carried the bee all the way back to its home. the bee was happy and said, "thank you, wind!" from that day on, the bee never ate too much again.

once upon a time, there was a bald man named tom. tom had a small house. he lived there all alone. tom had a rag that he liked very much. he used the rag to clean his house every day. one day, tom went outside to play. he forgot to close the door. the wind blew the rag out of the house. tom was sad. he looked for the rag, but he could not find it. tom walked down the road. he saw a big tree. the rag was in the tree! tom was happy. he took the rag and went back home. this time, tom remembered to close the door.

one day, a boy named tim found a hat. it was not a regular hat. it was big and red. tim put the hat on his head. tim walked to the park. he saw a cat. the cat said, "nice hat, tim!" tim smiled and said, "thank you, cat!" then, the wind began to blow. the hat flew off tim's head. the wind struck the hat high into a tree. tim was sad. the cat climbed the tree and got the hat. tim was happy again. they played together all day.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tim. tim loved to play with dough. he would build big towers and small houses with the dough. one day, tim found a hidden box in his room. inside the box, there was a note. the note said, "build something with this magic dough and it will come to life." tim was very excited. he started to build a small dog with the magic dough. when tim was done, the dough dog came to life! but, it was not a real dog. it was a magic dough dog that could talk! tim and the magic dough dog became best friends and had many fun days together. the end.

one day, a little girl named lucy went for a walk. the sun was shining, and the birds were singing. lucy saw an enormous tree. she wanted to play under it. suddenly, the sky turned dark, and it started to rain. lucy wanted to stay dry, so she looked for an umbrella. she found a big, red umbrella under the enormous tree. lucy opened the umbrella and played under it. the rain made fun sounds on the umbrella. when the rain stopped, lucy closed the umbrella and went home. she was happy she found the big, red umbrella under the enormous tree.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named poppy. poppy loved to stretch her arms in the morning when she woke up. one day, she went for a walk and met a big, amazing tree. "hello, tree!" said poppy. "you are so big and amazing! can you stretch like me?" the tree shook its leaves and said, "yes, poppy! i can stretch my branches up to the sky!" poppy was very happy. she and the tree stretched together every day. they became the best of friends, and lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a big, thick book. this book liked to lie on a table. every wednesday, a little girl named sue would come and read the book. one wednesday, sue saw a picture of a cat in the book. she liked the cat. the cat had a big, red ball. sue wanted to find the cat and play with the ball. the next wednesday, sue went to the park. she saw the cat from the book. the cat had the big, red ball. sue and the cat played with the ball all day. they became best friends, just like in the book.

once upon a time, there was a little monster. this monster liked to play and have fun. he had a big dream. he wanted to be successful at jumping high. one day, he saw a big tree. the little monster wanted to jump up and touch the top. he tried to spring up, but he couldn't jump high enough. he kept trying, but he needed help. his friend, the bunny, came to help. the bunny taught the monster how to spring up high. they practiced and practiced. the monster got better and better. at last, the monster was successful! he jumped so high and touched the top of the tree. they were both very happy.

one day, a little boy named tim found a flexible toy snake. he liked the toy snake very much. he played with the toy snake all day. they had a lot of fun together. at night, tim made a wish. he said, "i wish my toy snake could talk and hug me." then, something magical happened. the toy snake came to life! the toy snake said, "hi, tim! i can talk now. thank you for your wish!" tim was very happy. he hugged the toy snake and said, "you are my best friend." they played together and had even more fun.

one day, a boy named tim went to the park. he saw his friend, sue. sue was sad. her shoe had a big knot. tim wanted to help sue. "let me replace the knot," tim said. he was calm. he worked on the knot. but then, a big dog came. the dog took sue's shoe. "hey! give it back!" sue said. the dog did not listen. tim and sue ran after the dog. they wanted the shoe back. at last, they found the dog. the dog was with a baby bird. the bird had a hurt wing. the dog had used the shoe to make a soft bed for the bird. tim and sue were happy. they let the bird keep the shoe.

mia was walking in the park when she suddenly saw a bone. curious, she went over to take a closer look. as soon as she touched it, the bone became cold. she gasped and took a step back. "what's wrong mia?" asked her mom, who had been watching from a distance. "it's cold!" said mia, pointing at the bone. mia's mom laughed and said, "it's alright mia. that bone has been in the ground for a long time and it was cold when you touched it, that's all." mia nodded, understanding. she smiled and the two of them continued walking in the park.

one day, a boy named tom went to play at the park. it was sunny, so he wore his sunglasses. he saw his friend, sue, and they decided to play catch with a ball. tom threw the ball to sue, but it went too high! the ball landed in a wet puddle. sue got the ball and threw it back to tom. they both laughed because the ball was wet and made their hands wet too. they played until the sun went down. tom and sue said goodbye and went home. tom put his sunglasses away and thought about the fun day. he couldn't wait to play with sue again.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. he lived in a small igloo with his family. the igloo was very cold, but tim and his family were happy. one day, tim's mom told him to behave. she said, "tim, if you behave, we will have a great day!" tim wanted to have a great day, so he decided to behave. tim played with his toys and helped his mom clean the igloo. they had a great day together. tim's mom was very happy that he behaved, and they had a big hug before bed.

once upon a time, there was a friendly little boy named tim. tim was going to start school soon. he was very happy and excited about it. on the first day of school, tim met a new pupil named sally. sally was sad because she did not have any friends. tim thought that he could be sally's friend, so he said "hi" to her. tim and sally played together all day. they had so much fun at school. at the end of the day, sally was not sad anymore. she was happy because she had a new friend. and tim was happy too, because he helped sally. they were friends forever.

once upon a time, there was a pink bunny named bop. bop loved lunch time. one day, bop saw a big, yummy carrot across the street. he wanted to eat it for lunch. bop's mommy said, "bop, don't go! the street is not safe!" but bop could not resist the big, yummy carrot. he hopped across the street. bop got the carrot, but a big, mean dog saw him. the dog chased bop. bop was scared. he hopped and hopped, but the dog caught him. the dog took bop's carrot and bop was sad. he should have listened to his mommy.

once upon a time, there was a princess. she lived in a big castle with her mom and dad. the princess was sad and miserable because she lost her favorite toy. one day, she went to the park to look for her toy. she looked under the trees and behind the bushes. she asked her friends if they saw her toy, but no one knew where it was. then, a kind squirrel found her toy and returned it to her. the princess was so happy to have her toy back. she hugged the squirrel and thanked it for helping her. from that day on, the princess was never miserable again.

one day, a big ostrich named ollie went for a walk. he felt uncomfortable because his face was dirty. he saw a small pond and thought, "i can wipe my face there!" when ollie got to the pond, he saw a little bird named benny. benny was sad because he could not wipe his face. he was too small to reach the water. ollie had an idea to help benny. ollie told benny to stand on his back. benny did as ollie said. now benny could reach the water! benny wiped his face and felt much better. ollie wiped his face too. they both felt clean and happy.

once upon a time, there was a cheerful pig named pinky. pinky loved to travel and see new things. one day, he decided to go on a big trip. pinky walked and walked, and he saw many fun things. he saw a big red ball, a funny dog, and a pretty flower. pinky was very happy to see all these new things. at the end of the day, pinky went back to his home. he was very tired, but he was also very happy. pinky told all his friends about his trip, and they all wanted to travel too. they all had a great time together.

one day, a little cat named mimi was very tired. mimi wanted to relax. she looked for a nice place to lie down. mimi saw a big open box. the box was in the shape of a circle. mimi thought it was perfect. mimi jumped into the circle box. she curled up and closed her eyes. mimi began to relax in the open circle box. she felt so happy and warm. the sun was shining on her soft fur. soon, mimi's friends came to play. they saw mimi in the open circle box. they all wanted to relax too. so, they found their own circle boxes. all the friends relaxed in their open circle boxes, and they smiled.

once upon a time, there was a rich boy named tim. tim lived in a big house with a big garden. in the garden, there were many insects. tim liked to play with the insects. one day, tim met a new insect. it was a tiny bug. tim said, "hi, bug! i want to test how fast you can run." the bug said, "okay, tim! let's race." tim and the bug started to race. they ran and ran. the bug was very fast. tim was happy to have a new friend. they played together all day in the big garden.

one day, a boy named tim saw snow outside. he was eager to play. he put on his coat, hat, and boots. tim ran outside to have fun. tim saw his friend, sue. sue was making a snowman. "can i help you?" tim asked. sue said, "yes, please! we can finish it together." they put a hat on the snowman and gave it a big smile. when they finished, tim and sue played in the snow. they threw snowballs and laughed. they had a great time. at the end of the day, they went home happy and warm.

once upon a time, there was a big, tough bell. the bell liked to ring loudly. one day, the bell saw a magazine on the ground. the bell wanted to read the magazine, but it could not. a little girl named jane walked by. she saw the bell and the magazine. she picked up the magazine and started to read it. the bell wanted to read too, so it rang loudly to get jane's attention. "can you read the magazine to me?" the bell asked. jane looked at the bell and said, "yes, i can read it to you." jane started to read the magazine to the bell. they were both very happy.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim loved to play baseball. he played every day with his friends. but one day, the baseball was dull. it did not bounce or fly far when they hit it. tim was sad. he did not want to play with the dull baseball. so, he went to his room and took a nap. when he woke up, he hoped the baseball would be better. but when he went outside, the baseball was still dull. tim and his friends could not play their fun game. they tried to play, but it was not the same. in the end, they all went home sad because the dull baseball made their game no fun.

one day, a unique cat named sam went for a march. he liked to march because it made him feel big and strong. as he marched, he saw his friend, a dog named max. max asked, "sam, can i march with you?" sam said, "yes, let's march together!" so, they marched side by side. they were having so much fun that they did not see the rock in the path. sam tripped on the rock and fell down. max helped sam get up and said, "that was a big trip! are you okay?" sam said, "yes, i am fine. thank you for helping me." they both laughed and continued to march together, now watching out for rocks.

once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named tom. tom liked to sleep all day and play all night. he lived in a small house with a little girl named lucy. one day, while tom was napping, he heard a loud noise outside. he saw a big box with a sword inside. tom didn't know what would happen next, but he was very curious. he picked up the sword with his mouth and started to play. suddenly, the sword began to glow, and tom became a brave knight! tom was not lazy anymore. he protected lucy and their house from scary monsters. they were safe and happy together.

one day, tom went to the park with his mom. they saw a big, old oak tree. tom's mom said, "tom, can you count how many leaves are on the oak tree?" tom started to count. while tom was counting, a clean, white cat jumped out of the tree. "wow!" said tom. "i did not see you up there!" the cat said, "hello, tom! i live in the oak tree. can you help me find my toy?" tom and the cat looked under the oak tree. they found the toy! it was a small, red ball. the cat was very happy. "thank you, tom!" said the cat. tom and the cat played together under the oak tree.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim loved peanuts very much. he would eat peanuts every day. he had a big bag of peanuts in his room. one day, tim wanted to eat some peanuts. but when he looked in his room, the bag was not there. tim was sad. he missed his peanuts. he looked everywhere in his house for the bag. tim found his bag of peanuts outside in the yard. the bag was dirty. tim was not happy. but he cleaned the bag and ate some peanuts. tim was happy again. he did not miss his peanuts anymore.

one day, a boy named tim was eager to paint. he got his paint and brush and went to the big tree. he started to paint the tree with many colors. tim was very happy. his friend, sam, came and saw tim's paint on the tree. sam said, "you should not paint the tree. it can spoil the tree." tim did not listen. he kept painting the tree. later, a big wind came. the wind blew the paint off the tree. the paint flew into the air and landed on tim and sam. they were covered in paint! tim was sad because he spoiled his clothes, but sam just laughed. they both learned not to spoil trees with paint.

one day, a little yellow bird was playing in the rain. it had so much fun jumping in the puddles and getting wet. when the rain stopped, the little bird was very wet and cold. the little bird saw a big tree and flew to it. it sat under the tree to get dry. the warm sun came out and helped to dry the little bird's wet feathers. the bird felt better and warmer. then, a kind squirrel came to the little bird. the squirrel gave the bird a soft massage with its tiny hands. the bird felt so happy and relaxed. now the little bird was dry, warm, and ready to play again.

one day, a little boy named tim found a magic rock. he picked it up and made a wish. he wished he could run very fast. the rock made his wish come true. now, tim could rush like the wind. tim was so happy he could rush fast. he did not know that the rock could only give one wish. he was ignorant about the magic rock's rules. tim wanted to make more wishes, but he couldn't. tim learned that it's important to know about things before making wishes. even though he was ignorant at first, he was happy with his one wish. now, tim could rush fast and play with his friends.

one day, a little dog named spot was playing in the yard. spot liked to dig and find useful things. he saw a big tree and thought, "i will dig here and find something good." as he dug, he met a small bug named buzz. buzz said, "hi, spot. can you trust me? i know where a big surprise is." spot thought for a moment and said, "okay, i trust you. show me the surprise." they went to a small hole in the yard. buzz said, "dig here, spot." spot dug and dug until he found a big, shiny bone. he was very happy and said, "thank you, buzz. i am glad i trusted you!"

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim had a notebook. he loved to draw and write in it. one day, he took his notebook to the park. at the park, tim saw a foolish dog. the dog was running around and barking loudly. tim laughed and wanted to draw the dog in his notebook. but he needed to remain still to draw well. tim sat down and stayed very still. he drew the funny dog in his notebook. the dog saw tim and came over to look. the dog liked the drawing and wagged its tail. tim and the dog became good friends, and they played together at the park every day.

john saw his blanket covering the grass in the park. "let's go play," he said to his mom. his mom smiled and said, "ok, but don't forget your blanket if it gets too hot." john and his mom played in the park until it got too hot. john grabbed his blanket and used it to cover himself up. it was like a big, soft hug. john and his mom sat under the blanket and drank some cool lemonade. "this is nice and cool," john said. the blanket felt so soft and warm, and it kept john cool. he smiled and said, "i am so glad we brought this blanket with us today!"

once upon a time, there was a little girl named sue. she loved to play outside. one day, she saw a smelly sock on the ground. sue picked it up and felt the texture. it was soft and wet. sue wanted to know who the sock belonged to. she walked around and asked her friends, "is this your smelly sock?" her friends said no. sue kept asking people she saw, but no one knew whose sock it was. finally, sue asked her mom. her mom laughed and said, "sue, that is your smelly sock! it must have fallen out of your bag." sue giggled and put the sock back in her bag. she was happy to find the sock's home.

david and his mommy were at the airport. david liked to slide at the airport, and he thought it was very fun. he was very creative and he liked to make up games as he slid around. mommy said to david, "it is time to slide, let's go!" david said excitedly, "yay!" and he started to slide. he went very quickly and he laughed the whole time. he went around and around until he was very tired. mommy said, "time to go home, david!" and he said, "ok!" david was very happy. he had had a very creative day sliding around the airport.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. he loved to walk outside and play. one day, he saw dark clouds in the sky. tim felt ready for an adventure. as tim walked, he saw his friend, lily. "lily, let's play!" tim said. lily looked at the sky and said, "okay, but we must be careful of the lightning." they held hands and walked together. they played and laughed until they saw a bright lightning in the sky. "let's go home, tim," said lily. they ran home, feeling tired but happy. they had a fun day, even with the lightning.

the trees were turning brown. there were piles of leaves on the ground. it was winter. squeaky and slider were outside playing. they were having a lot of fun. squeaky saw something bright and nice. it was a shiny red and yellow bike. he wanted to ride it! he paused for a moment, but then he got on and started to ride. slider was happy too. slider saw a slide in the park. she went to it and paused for a moment. it looked cold. but then she climbed to the top, and went down the slide. it was so much fun! the winter was nice. they played until it got dark. then they went home, tired but happy.

once upon a time, there was a little boy. he wanted to race, so he picked up his old cloth. it was ancient, but he thought it would be perfect for a race. so off he went, faster and faster. he started to gain on his opponents as he raced. suddenly, the cloth ripped! no one could help him, and he stopped in the middle of the race. but he had gone so fast that he could not stop in time, and he smashed into a building. the boy was very sad and did not finish the race. he had to go home, and his old cloth was ruined. the ancient cloth had a bad ending and the little boy will never forget it.

once upon a time, there was a cheerful family. they wanted to go on a vacation. they packed their bags and went to the beach. at the beach, they saw a show. there were people dancing and singing. the family watched and listened. they liked the show a lot. when the show was over, the family clapped their hands. they were very happy. the people in the show smiled and bowed. the family's vacation was fun and they went home with big smiles.

once upon a time, there was a cool cat named tom. tom loved to play with puzzles. he would sit and play with them all day. he liked how they made him think. one day, tom found a new puzzle. it was very big and had many pieces. tom was excited to test his skills. he started to put the pieces together. it was hard, but he did not give up. after a long time, tom finished the puzzle. it was a picture of a big, cool tree. tom was very happy. he had tested himself and did a great job. tom knew that he could do anything if he tried.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tom. he had a penny. he wanted to buy a candy. tom was very happy. tom saw a mighty big hill. he wanted to go up the hill. he tried and tried to succeed. he did not give up. tom was almost at the top. then, something unexpected happened. a big wind came and took tom's penny away. tom was sad. he did not get the candy. the end.

one day, a boy named tim went for a walk. he saw a big pie on a table. tim was very hungry. he wanted to eat the pie, but it was not his. tim felt impatient. he saw a girl named sue near the table. tim asked, "can i have some pie?" sue smiled and said, "yes, you can have a small piece." tim and sue ate the pie together. they were happy and full. after eating, they continued to walk and play. they became good friends.

once upon a time, there was a painter. he liked to roll paint on the walls. one day, he saw a big ball. the ball was very alert. it could jump and play with the painter. one day, the painter and the alert ball were playing. they were rolling the paint together. they made a big mess. the painter was sad. he did not want to clean the mess. but then, the alert ball had an idea. it jumped into the paint and started to roll. the ball rolled over the mess and made a new picture on the wall. the painter was happy. they made a beautiful picture together. and they lived happily ever after.

one day, a young boy named tom went to play outside. tom liked to move fast and have fun. he saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. tom was not very careful when he climbed the tree. he just wanted to go up and up. tom's friend, sue, came to play with him. sue was a careful youth. she saw tom in the tree and was worried. she told tom to be careful, but tom did not listen. he kept moving up the tree, higher and higher. tom reached the top of the tree and was happy. but, he was not careful. he moved too fast and fell down. tom got hurt very bad. sue was sad and wished tom had been more careful.

one day, a big red car wanted to solve a problem. the car was very impatient. it wanted to find its way to the park where all the children played. the red car asked a blue car, "how do i get to the park?" the blue car said, "go straight, then turn left, and you will find the park." the red car was happy and said, "thank you, blue car!" the red car went straight and turned left. it found the park and saw all the children playing. the children were happy to see the big red car. the car's problem was solved, and it was not impatient anymore.

once upon a time, there was a charming little boy named tim. tim loved to eat waffles for breakfast. every day, he would wake up to the smell of sweet waffles made by his mom. one sunny morning, as the sun started to shine, tim saw a talking waffle on his plate. the waffle said, "hello, tim! i am wally the waffle. let's be friends!" tim was very surprised but happy to have a new friend. together, tim and wally the waffle played outside in the sunshine. they laughed and had fun all day long. in the end, tim learned that even a waffle could be a charming friend.

once upon a time, there was an old dog named spot. spot lived near a big field. spot loved to run and play in the field with his friends. one day, spot wanted to play with his friends. but he had to delay his playtime because it was raining. spot waited and waited for the rain to stop. he looked out the window, hoping the sun would come out soon. finally, the rain stopped and the sun came out. spot ran to the field and found his friends. they played all day in the field, running and jumping. spot was very happy to play with his friends after the rain. and they all had a great day together.

once upon a time, there was a mighty bird named bobo. bobo loved to fly high in the sky and dive into the water. he had many friends who lived in the big tree. one day, bobo saw a shiny thing in the water. he told his friend, "i see something shiny. i will dive and get it." his friend said, "be careful, bobo!" bobo took a deep breath and dove into the water. he grabbed the shiny thing and brought it up. it was a big bag of candy! all the friends in the tree were happy and shared the candy. they all said, "thank you, mighty bobo, for the sweet treat!"

once upon a time, there was a prince. he was eager to ride his horse. the prince loved his horse very much. one day, the prince and his horse went for a ride. they rode through the woods. they saw many trees and animals. at the end of the day, the prince and his horse went back home. they were happy and tired. they had a fun day riding together.

once upon a time, there was a little gray mouse. the mouse lived in a tight hole in a big tree. the mouse had many friends who lived in the tree too. one day, a small bird came to the tree. the bird did not know how to find food. the gray mouse wanted to help the bird. so, the mouse said, "i can explain how to find food." the mouse and the bird went to look for food together. the gray mouse showed the bird where to find seeds and bugs. the bird was very happy. the mouse and the bird became good friends. they played and ate together every day.

once upon a time there was a little girl called abbie. she was three years old and loved to wear colourful dresses. one day, she saw a film which had a harmless character. his name was joe and he was wearing a blue suit. abbie said to her mum, 'i want to wear a suit like joe!' her mum smiled and replied, 'that sounds like a great idea!' so abbie and her mum went to the shops and bought abbie her very own blue suit. abbie felt so grown up in her suit and twirled around and around. she loved showing her friends her new clothes. everywhere she went she made people smile. the end.

one day, a little boy named tim went to the farm with his mom. tim was very glad. he wanted to find a big pumpkin. they saw many pumpkins on the farm. tim saw a big pumpkin. he wanted to examine it. he looked at the pumpkin closely. the pumpkin was round and orange. tim was very happy. he asked his mom if he could take the pumpkin home. his mom said yes, but tim had to carry the pumpkin himself. tim tried to pick up the pumpkin, but it was too heavy. the pumpkin fell on tim's foot. tim cried. his mom hugged him. they went home without the pumpkin. tim was sad.

one day, tim saw a package. it was big and blue. tim wanted to touch it. he thought, "who put this here?" tim touched the package. it made a funny sound. tim was scared. he thought, "this is a stupid package." tim's mom came. she said, "don't be scared, tim. it's just a toy." tim was happy. he played with the toy.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tim. tim had a big cabinet in his room. it was a very important cabinet because it held all of his toys. one day, tim's mom asked him to clean his room. tim started to put all of his toys into the cabinet. he put his cars, his blocks, and his teddy bear inside. when tim was done, his room was clean and all of his toys were in the important cabinet. tim's mom was very happy. they both smiled and had a fun day playing with the toys together.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim loved to run fast. one day, he saw a race. he wanted to win a medal. tim felt excited. in the race, tim ran very fast, but he started to feel frustrated because he couldn't run faster. he saw a girl running faster than him. tim said, "i want to run as fast as you!" the girl said, "keep trying, you can do it!" tim tried harder and felt his legs burn. he ran faster and faster. at the end of the race, tim won a medal. he felt happy and proud.

once upon a time, a thin cat named tom lived in a small house. today, tom wanted to sleep all day. he found a cozy bed and started to sleep. suddenly, a big dog named max came into the house. max saw tom sleeping and wanted to play. max barked very loud, and tom woke up. tom was not happy, but he had an idea. tom acted like he was still asleep. max came closer to tom, and tom jumped up. max was so surprised that he ran away. tom was happy, and he went back to sleep.

one day, a boy named tim got a smelly sock. he did not like the smell. tim had an idea. he would send a picture to his friend, sam, to show him the smelly sock. tim took a picture of the sock and gave it to sam. sam looked at the picture and said, "wow, that sock looks smelly!" sam wanted to help tim. he told tim to wash the sock. tim washed the sock and it was not smelly anymore. tim and sam were happy. they played with their toys and laughed.

one day, a little girl named daisy went to play in her yard. she saw an impressive, big hill of dirt. daisy wanted to make the dirt hill even more fun. daisy called her friend, tom. "come play with me!" she said. tom came over, and they both decided to bury some of their toys in the dirt hill. they dug holes, put their toys in, and covered them with dirt. it was so much fun! after they buried all their toys, daisy and tom tried to find them again. they dug and dug, and found each toy one by one. they laughed and played all day, until the sun went down.

once upon a time, in a small village, there was a light that everyone could see. this light was very special. it was in a big tree and it made the village bright and happy. one day, a little boy named tim wanted to have the light from the tree. he asked his friends to help him. they all said yes, and they went to the tree together. they climbed up the tree and got the light. they were happy to have it. they played with the light all day long. the village was still bright and happy, and everyone was glad that tim and his friends could have the light too.

one day, a little girl named lily went to the ocean with her mom. they saw a big crab. lily wanted to grab the crab. her mom said, "no, lily! it might be disgusting." lily did not listen. she grabbed the crab. the crab was not happy. it pinched lily's hand. "ouch!" lily cried. her mom said, "i told you not to grab it." lily went home with a red hand. she was sad. she learned that she should listen to her mom. the day was not fun anymore.

once upon a time, there was a polite cat named kitty. kitty lived in a small house with many stairs. every day, kitty liked to play on the stairs. one sunny day, kitty met a new friend, a dog named spot. spot wanted to play on the stairs too. kitty said, "let's play together, spot!" so, kitty and spot played on the stairs all day long. after playing, kitty and spot were very tired. they saw a sign that said, "nap time." kitty said, "let's take a nap, spot." spot agreed, and they both took a nice nap under the sign. they became best friends and played on the stairs every day.

once upon a time, there was a pale dog named sam. sam loved to soak in the sun and eat sausages. one day, sam saw a sausage on the ground. sam said, "yum! a sausage for me!" he ran to the sausage and started to eat it. but the sausage was old and not good. sam felt sick. his tummy hurt. he could not soak in the sun anymore. the end.

once upon a time, there was a big lake. in the lake, there were many fish. the fish liked to swim and play all day. one day, a little boy named tim came to the lake. he saw the fish and wanted to play with them. tim said to the fish, "hi, fish! i want to play with you. can i come into the lake?" the fish said, "yes, but please do not disturb the important rock at the bottom of the lake. it is very special to us." tim went into the lake and played with the fish. they had a lot of fun. tim was very careful not to disturb the important rock. the fish were happy, and they all became good friends.

one day, a cat and a dog were in the park. the cat was glad because the sun was out. the dog saw a big ball near a tree. he ran to the ball and gave it a rub. the ball felt funny, not like other balls. the cat went to the dog and looked at the ball. she saw a point on the ball. she gave the point a rub too. when she did that, the ball started to shake. the cat and dog jumped back, scared. all of a sudden, the ball opened up! inside the ball was a little bird. the bird was happy to be free. the cat and the dog were surprised. they played with the bird all day and became good friends.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. he had a noisy toy car. he loved to play with it all day. one day, he saw a door. the door was old and had a patch on it. tim wanted to open the door. he pushed and pushed, but the door did not open. he tried again and again. he wanted to see what was behind the door. finally, the door opened. tim went inside. it was very dark. he heard a loud growl. a big, scary monster came out. the monster was not happy. the monster chased tim out of the room. tim was very sad and scared. from that day, he never tried to open that door again.

once upon a time, there was a blue bird named billy. billy was a very useful bird. he liked to help his friends in the forest. one day, billy saw his friend, the squirrel, looking sad. "what is wrong?" asked billy. the squirrel said, "i can't find my nuts. i hid them, but now i don't know where they are." billy wanted to help his friend. billy flew up high to observe the forest. he looked and looked until he saw a pile of nuts under a tree. "i found them!" he called down to the squirrel. the squirrel was so happy that he could eat his nuts again. they both laughed and played together all day.

sam was three years old, and loved to write. one day, he was writing on a big piece of paper when his mom came into the room. she gave him a big muffin and said, "here's a muffin! do you want to write on it?" sam looked at the muffin and smiled. he got a pen and started writing on the muffin. he wrote his name, and other things too. it was fun! suddenly, it started to rain outside. muffin and pen got wet. sam looked sad. his mom said, "don't worry, sam. we can get you a new muffin and a new pen. will you write on it again?" sam smiled and said, "yes, i will write on it again!"

once upon a time, there was a big structure in a town. it was incredible and everyone loved it. one sunny day, a little boy named tim went to the structure to play. tim saw a nice spot to sit near the structure. he sat down and looked at the incredible structure. he was so happy to be there. he played all day long, laughing and having fun. but then, the sky turned dark and it started to rain. tim was sad and he didn't want to leave the structure. the rain got heavier and the structure fell down. tim was very sad, and he went home with a bad ending to his day.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named mia. she was anxious because she wanted to help her mom in the kitchen. mia's mom was making dinner for the family. mia's mom gave her a job. she asked mia to polish the forks. mia was very happy to help. she took a cloth and cleaned every fork until they were shiny and bright. when dinner was ready, mia put the shiny forks on the table. everyone was happy and thanked mia for her help. mia felt proud and not anxious anymore. she knew she could help her mom again in the future.

one day, a little boy named tim was playing outside. he saw a round object. it was a ball! tim was very happy and enthusiastic to play with it. tim decided to kick the ball. he kicked it high and far. he laughed and clapped his hands. he ran to the ball and kicked it again and again. after a while, tim's friend, lily, came to play with him. they both kicked the ball together. they had so much fun. at the end of the day, tim and lily were tired but happy. they went home and told their moms and dads about the fun they had with the ball.

once upon a time, there was a smart car named tim. tim loved to drive around the town. one day, while driving, he saw a big stamp on the ground. tim stopped and looked at the stamp. it had a picture of a happy face on it. he wanted to show it to his friend, the bus named ben. so, he picked it up and drove to find ben. when tim found ben, he said, "look, ben! i found a big stamp!" ben looked at the stamp and smiled. "that's a nice stamp, tim!" he said. they both felt happy and drove around the town together, showing the big stamp to all their friends.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim was very enthusiastic about his new costume. it was a big, red costume with a long cape. he wanted to show it to all his friends. one day, tim went to his friend's house to play. he didn't mention his new costume to his friend. he wanted it to be a surprise. he put on his costume and ran outside to show everyone. but as tim ran, his long cape got caught on a tree. he fell down and his costume ripped. tim was very sad. his beautiful costume was ruined, and his surprise was spoiled. the end.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she liked to pretend she was a big chef. lily had a toy kitchen with a jug, a pan, and a spoon. she was very proud of her kitchen. one day, lily's friend, ben, came to play. they decided to pretend to make soup. lily filled the jug with water and poured it into the pan. ben stirred the soup with the spoon. they laughed and had fun. once upon a time, in a small town, there was a modest farm. on this farm, there were many animals and plants. one of the plants was a tall corn. one sunny day, a little girl named mia went to the farm. she wanted to meet all the animals and plants. mia saw the tall corn and said, "hi, i am mia. i want to meet you." the tall corn was happy to meet mia. they played together all day long. mia and the tall corn became very good friends. they had a lot of fun on the modest farm.

once upon a time, there was a lively child named ben. ben loved to look at everything around him. he liked to look at the sky, the trees, and the animals in the park. one day, ben went to the park with his mom. he saw a little dog playing with a ball. ben looked at the dog and smiled. he wanted to play with the dog too. so, ben and the dog played together, and they had lots of fun. after playing, ben and his mom went home. ben was very happy. he told his mom all about the dog and how they played together. ben's mom smiled and gave him a big hug. ben knew he had a great day at the park.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she had an adorable dog named max. max loved to walk and play with lily every day. they were best friends. one sunny day, lily and max went for a walk to the post. max was very happy and wagged his tail. they saw many pretty flowers and birds on their way. lily and max liked looking at all the colors. when they reached the post, lily put a letter in the box. max barked and wagged his tail. they both walked back home, smiling and laughing. lily and max had a fun day together.
