once upon a time, there was a big wolf. the wolf liked to play catch with his friends. he had many friends in the forest. one sunny day, the wolf and his friends were playing catch with a ball. the wolf was very alert. he was quick to catch the ball when it came his way. his friends were happy to see him play so well. as they played, a little bird came to watch them. the bird liked how the wolf played catch. the bird asked if it could play too. the wolf and his friends said yes. they all played catch together and had a fun day.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. one day, tim went to play with his friend, sam. they were very happy to see each other. tim saw a big ball in sam's yard. once upon a time, in a small house, there was a girl named sue. sue loved to bake. one day, she wanted to bake a cake. she wanted to put cream on the cake. sue was very happy. sue's brother, tom, was not nice. tom wanted to eat the cake. he did not want to wait. sue said, "no, tom! the cake is not ready yet." tom was not happy. he wanted the cake now. sue knew that tom was harmless. she had an idea. sue gave tom a big bowl of cream. tom was happy. he ate the cream and forgot about the cake. sue baked the cake and shared it with tom. they both were happy.

once upon a time, there was a clean room. in the room, there was a pretty picture on the wall. it was a picture of a happy sun and a big tree. a little boy named timmy liked to look at the picture every day. one day, timmy wanted to touch the picture. he got a chair and stood on it. he reached up to touch the picture. but the chair started to wobble. then, the chair began to fall. timmy and the picture fell down too. the picture broke and timmy cried. the clean room was not clean anymore. the pretty picture was gone and timmy was sad.

one day, a little boy named tim saw a high tree. the tree was very dirty. tim wanted to help the tree. he made a promise to the tree. "i will clean you, tree," tim said. tim asked his mom for help. his mom gave him a big cloth. tim started to clean the tree. he was happy to see the tree become clean. the tree was happy too. as tim cleaned the tree, he found a small bird. the bird was stuck in the dirty tree. tim helped the bird get free. the bird was happy and flew high in the sky. tim smiled and knew that his promise was kept.

once upon a time, there was a red restaurant. it was a special place where everyone liked to go. the restaurant had a big red door and red chairs inside. one day, a little girl named lucy went to the red restaurant with her mommy and daddy. they were all very happy. lucy saw a nice red balloon near her chair. she loved her red balloon so much. at the end of their meal, lucy's mommy gave her a big kiss on her cheek. lucy smiled and gave her mommy a kiss back. then, lucy gave her red balloon a little kiss too. they all left the red restaurant feeling happy and full.

one day, a little girl named lucy went to the store with her mom. she saw a pretty, new toy. she asked her mom if she could buy it. her mom said yes. when they got home, lucy wanted to show her toy to her friend, max. she thought it would be fun to wrap the toy like a gift. she found some paper and a stamp to put on it. lucy liked the stamp because it had a picture of a big, red car. lucy took the wrapped toy to max's house. max was happy to see the gift. he opened it and saw the modern toy. they played with the toy all day and had lots of fun.

once upon a time, there was a little seed. it wanted to grow big and strong. it needed sun, water, and good soil to grow. it also needed a reliable friend to help it grow. one day, a little girl found the seed. she took a note to remember to water the seed every day. she put the seed in the ground and gave it water. the seed was happy to have a friend. the little seed started to grow. it grew and grew, and soon it was a big plant. the girl and the plant were happy together. they were the best of friends, and they knew they could always count on each other.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. lily loved to play with her toy cars. one day, her mom said, "lily, i want to introduce you to someone new." lily was very excited. lily's mom took her to meet a big bus driver named tom. tom was a little impatient, but he liked to make kids happy. "hi, lily!" tom said. "do you want to see my big bus?" lily smiled and said, "yes, please!" tom showed lily the big bus, and she was so happy. lily said, "thank you, tom! i love your big bus!" tom smiled and said, "you're welcome, lily. i'm glad you like it!" and they all had a fun day together.

once there was a girl named grace. grace liked to play with her toys on the shelf. she liked to take her teddy bear and hold it in her hands. one day, grace noticed a strange hairy thing on the shelf. it was furry and had big eyes. grace was a bit scared but she wanted to see what it was. she slowly reached out and held it. it was a big, furry spider! it felt soft and squishy in her hands. grace was still scared and she put it back on the shelf. grace was happy that she held the hairy spider but now she was never going to touch another spider again!

once upon a time, there was a big, round barrel. it was full of clear water. the barrel was in a nice, green park. one sunny day, a little boy named tim came to the park. he was very thirsty. he saw the barrel and wanted to drink the clear water. but the barrel was too tall for him to reach. tim had an idea. he kneeled down and found a big, flat rock. he put the rock near the barrel. then, he stood on the rock and could reach the clear water. tim drank the water and felt happy. the end.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim knew that every morning, the sun would rise. he liked to watch the sunrise because it made the sky look pretty. one day, tim woke up and saw that the sky was dark. he was sad because he thought he missed the sunrise. tim's mom told him, "don't worry, it's just a bad day. the sun will rise again tomorrow." the next day, tim woke up early and saw the beautiful sunrise. he was happy because he knew that even on bad days, the sun would always rise again.

once upon a time, there was a little fish named tim. tim lived in a big reef with his family. tim was an ordinary fish, just like his friends. one day, tim met a new friend named sam. sam said, "hi, tim! do you want to play with me?" tim felt happy and said, "yes, let's play together!" while they were playing, they found a secret door in the reef. tim and sam went inside and saw a big treasure chest. they did not expect to find it there! tim and sam felt very excited and shared the treasure with all their friends. now, tim was not just an ordinary fish, he was a hero in the reef.

one day, a little girl named mia found a rare post in her yard. it was a very pretty post with many colors. mia did not know where it came from. she thought maybe it was a gift from her friend, tom. mia went to tom's house and asked, "did you put the rare post in my yard?" tom said, "no, but i like it. let's dance around it and have fun!" so, mia and tom danced and laughed around the colorful post. every day, mia and tom would dance around the rare post. they had so much fun together. the post made them very happy. and they were the best of friends.

once upon a time, there was a family that wanted to have a successful party. so they gathered together to plan the party. the parents gathered some food and put it in a big bowl. then they gathered some decorations and made the house look fun. after everything was ready, everyone gathered around the bowl and sang happy songs. they were so excited! the party was a big success. everyone had fun, especially the three year old. she made many friends and was the centre of attention. at the end of the day, everyone gathered around to say goodbye. and that's how the successful party turned out.

once upon a time, there was a cute boy named tim. tim had a big, red ball. he liked to play with his ball every day. tim's ball was his best friend. one day, tim saw a big door. he wanted to enter the door with his ball. he thought he would find new friends to play with behind the door. so, tim and his ball entered the door. inside, tim found a big room with many toys. there were other boys and girls playing. they all liked tim's cute ball. they played together and had fun. tim and his ball made many new friends.

once upon a time, there was a smart little hedgehog named spike. he lived in a big forest. he had many friends, like the bird, the cat, and the dog. they loved to play together. one day, spike and his friends found a big red apple. they wanted to taste it. spike said, "let's share the apple." his friends agreed. they were very happy. spike used his sharp spikes to cut the apple into pieces. he gave a piece to each friend. they all tasted the apple and said, "yum! this is the best apple ever!" they were all very happy and played in the forest until it was time to go home.

one day, a little yellow bird named tim was playing in the park. he saw a big bell on the ground. tim wanted to make the bell ring. he tried to push it, but it was too heavy. a small girl named amy saw tim and asked, "do you need help?" tim nodded his head. amy used her toe to kick the bell. the bell started to ring loudly. tim and amy laughed and clapped their hands. they played with the bell all day. the yellow bird and the small girl became good friends. they loved to make the bell ring and hear its sound. they were very happy.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tim. he liked to play outside. one day, he found a big box. the box was locked. tim wanted to see what was inside the box. he thought it was a treasure. tim tried to unlock the box. it was not easy. he tried and tried. then, he found a key. the key was under a rock. tim was happy. he used the key to unlock the box. inside the box, there was a treasure! it had toys and candy. tim was very happy. he shared the treasure with his friends. they all played and ate candy together. it was a fun day for everyone.

one day, a girl named lily went to the fair. she saw many fun things like big balloons, yummy food, and pretty colors. lily was very happy to be at the fair. while at the fair, lily saw an old man who was sad. he lost his cane and could not walk well. lily wanted to help the old man, so she started to look for his cane. she looked near the food, by the balloons, and under the pretty colors. finally, lily found the cane near a big tree. she gave it to the old man and he was very happy. the old man thanked lily for her help. they both enjoyed the rest of the day at the fair together.

once upon a time in a small town, there was a grumpy cop named tom. he liked to sit on a big chair near the road. he watched the cars go by and made sure everyone was safe. one sunny day, a little girl named lily walked by the cop. she saw him sitting and looking grumpy. lily wanted to make him happy, so she gave him a pretty flower from her garden. tom the cop looked at the flower and smiled. he was not grumpy anymore. he thanked lily and they became good friends. from that day on, tom and lily would sit together and watch the cars go by, making sure everyone was safe and happy.

one day, a boy named tim found a pen on the floor. he was very proud of his new pen. he showed it to his mom and dad. they were happy for tim. tim went to the park to play with his friends. he saw a girl named sue. sue was sad because she lost her pen. tim felt bad for sue. he thought about what to do. tim decided to give sue the pen he found. he knelt down and gave it to her. sue was very happy and said thank you. tim felt good about helping his friend. the twist is that tim made a new friend and learned that sharing is good.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lucy. she had a toy named teddy. lucy and teddy loved to play and hug each other every day. one day, lucy could not find teddy. she looked under her bed, behind the door, and in the closet. lucy felt sad and missed her toy. she wanted to hug teddy and play with him. lucy asked her mommy for help. together, they looked all around the house. at last, they found teddy in the garden. lucy was so happy and felt successful. she gave teddy a big hug and promised to never lose him again. from that day on, lucy and teddy played happily ever after.

one day, a little girl named sue went with her mom to visit an ancient house. the house was very old and had many things inside. sue's mom told her not to touch anything. in the kitchen, sue saw a cup of coffee on the table. she wanted to drink it, but her mom said, "no, sue. ignore the coffee. it's not for you." sue was sad, but she listened to her mom. later, when her mom was not looking, sue saw the coffee again. she thought it looked tasty, so she drank it. suddenly, she felt sick. her mom found her and said, "sue, i told you not to drink the coffee." sue cried and felt very bad.

one day, tim and his mom made cocoa. they put it in big cups. tim was happy. he liked to drink cocoa on cold days. it made him feel warm and good. tim took a big sip of the cocoa. it was very hot! he felt dizzy for a moment. tim's mom told him to be careful. she said, "blow on it first, then drink it." tim did what his mom said. he blew on the cocoa. it was not too hot now. he drank it all up. tim and his mom smiled. they were happy to have cocoa on a cold day.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim felt dizzy one day. he did not know why. he went to his friend, sam, to talk about it. tim said to sam, "i feel dizzy, and i don't know why." sam thought for a moment and said, "did you have a big test at school today?" tim said, "yes, i had an exam. it was hard." sam and tim talked about the exam. they thought maybe tim felt dizzy because he was worried about the test. they decided to play a game to help tim feel better. after playing, tim did not feel dizzy anymore. they were happy and went to eat some ice cream.

once upon a time, there was a lovely queen. she lived in a big castle with her friends. the queen was very nice and everyone loved her. one day, the queen wanted to go to the park. she put on her pretty dress and her shiny crown. she walked to the park with her friends. they saw flowers, birds, and butterflies. the queen was very happy. at the park, the queen played with her friends. they ran, jumped, and laughed. the sun was shining and the sky was blue. after a fun day, the queen and her friends went back to the castle. they all had a good time and could not wait to go to the park again.

once upon a time, there was a hunter. he was very dependable. he always helped his friends. one day, he went to the forest to find food. in the forest, he met a big bear. the bear was not happy. the bear did not want the hunter to find food in the forest. the hunter felt scared, but he knew he had to be brave. the hunter talked to the bear. he said, "we can share the forest and be friends." the bear listened and agreed. they both felt happy. the hunter and the bear became good friends, and they shared the forest together.

one day, a playful dog went for a walk. he liked to run and jump in the park. the sun was shining, and the dog felt very happy. while walking, the dog saw a big red ball. he wanted to play with it, so he ran to the ball. but when he got close, the ball started to move! the dog was surprised. it turned out, the ball was not a ball at all! it was a big round cat who was sleeping. the cat woke up and felt playful too. they both laughed and played together in the park. the dog and the cat became very good friends.

one day, tom and sam went to a big, modern stadium. they wanted to watch a fun game. tom was very excited, but sam was not. sam wanted to go home and play with his toys. "why are you not happy?" tom asked sam. sam stared at the big stadium and said, "i don't like it here. it's too big and loud." tom felt sad for sam but wanted to watch the game. then, a nice man gave them big, soft headphones. sam put them on and the noise was not so loud anymore. sam smiled and said, "now i can watch the game with you!" tom and sam had a great time at the modern stadium.

once upon a time there was a friend who needed help. his eye was bad so he went to borrow an eye from his neighbor. when he saw the eye, he was very happy. the eye was very impressive. it was so shiny and special. his friend said it was perfect for him! so he put the eye in his head and it worked great! he was so excited with his new eye. he could see things he had never seen before. he thanked his neighbor for the wonderful eye. he was so happy that he could see better now. the end.

once upon a time, there was a new little bug. the bug liked to stay on a vine. the vine was green and long. the bug was happy to be on the vine. one day, the bug saw another bug on the vine. the new bug was big and red. the little bug was scared. the big bug said, "do not be scared. i am nice." the little bug and the big bug became friends. they played on the vine. but then, something unexpected happened. the big bug was not a bug at all. it was a red leaf! the little bug laughed and laughed. the leaf and the little bug stayed friends on the vine.

once upon a time, there was a small cat. the small cat liked to play with a ball. one day, the cat saw a bottle. the bottle had ink. the cat thought it was fun to play with the bottle. the cat played with the bottle and spilled the ink. the ink made a big mess. the cat saw the ink and thought it was water. the cat was thirsty and wanted to drink. the cat drank the ink. the ink was not good for the cat. the cat felt sick. the cat did not play with the ball anymore. the cat was not happy. the end.

once upon a time, in a small farm, there was a fat mule. the mule liked to eat a lot. he would eat all day and not share with others. one day, the mule saw a big red ball. he wanted to play with it. but he did not pause to think. he just ran to the ball. the other animals told him to stop, but he did not listen. the ball rolled down a hill. the fat mule ran after it. but he was too fat and slow. he fell down and got hurt. the other animals came to help. they learned that they should always pause and think before they do something.

one day, a pirate named tom went to a high hill. he wanted to teach his friend, a little bird, how to sing. tom loved to sing, and he wanted his friend to sing with him. "hello, little bird!" said tom. "i will teach you how to sing today." the little bird was happy and said, "yes, tom! i want to learn to sing with you." tom and the little bird sang together on the high hill. they sang loud and had fun. all the other animals heard them sing and came to the hill. they all sang together and had a great day.

once, a swing was swinging in the park. it moved up and down, back and forth. suddenly, a wolf walked in. he looked around and saw the swing. the wolf said, "hello swing! can i swing too?" the swing said, "yes, why not". the wolf climbed onto the swing and started to swing. the swing gave him a fine ride and the wolf had lots of fun. when the wolf finished swinging, he said a big thank you to the swing. the swing smiled and said "you're very welcome". then, the wolf said goodbye and he was gone.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tom. tom had a long rope with a big knot in it. the knot was very difficult. he wanted to show the knot to his friend, sam. tom went to sam's house. sam saw the difficult knot and tried to untie it. they pulled and pulled, but the knot did not come out. they tried very hard, but it was still difficult. at last, tom and sam were very tired. they could not untie the difficult knot. they were sad and went to their homes. the knot stayed in the rope, and they never played with it again.

once upon a time, there was a mighty dog named max. max was big and strong. he loved to spend his days playing with his friends. they would run, jump, and chase each other all day long. one day, max got sick. he felt very bad. his friends were sad, too. max's mom took him to the doctor. the doctor was a nice man who helped animals feel better. the doctor gave max some medicine. max took the medicine and soon felt better. he was a mighty dog again. max was so happy to spend time with his friends and play. they all lived happily ever after.

one day, a cat named tuna was very frustrated. tuna wanted to play with her ball, but it was stuck in a tree. she tried and tried to get it down, but she could not reach it. tuna was sad. then, tuna saw a big dog. the dog saw tuna was sad and wanted to help. the dog tried to get the ball from the tree, but he could not reach it either. the dog felt frustrated too. but then, something unexpected happened. the wind blew very hard and the tree moved. the tree yield the ball and it fell down. tuna and the dog were happy. they played with the ball together and became good friends.

once upon a time, a little boy named tim went to the airport with his mom and dad. they wanted to go on a big plane to visit grandma. tim was very excited. at the airport, they saw a man with a tough face. the man had a big bag of candy. he saw tim and offered him some candy. tim thought the candy looked yummy, but his mom said, "no, thank you." tim was sad, but he knew his mom was right. they got on the plane and went to visit grandma. but on the way, the plane had a problem. it had to go back to the airport. tim and his family did not get to see grandma that day.

one day, a big bossy bird saw a small grill. the bird wanted the grill to rise up in the sky. the bird tried to pick up the grill, but it was too heavy. the bossy bird asked other animals to help make the grill rise. the animals tried to help the bird, but they were not strong enough. the bossy bird was not happy. in the end, the grill did not rise. the bossy bird and the animals were sad. the bossy bird learned that not everything can rise.

one day, a big red truck was driving down the road. the truck was very sleepy, but it had to keep going. the truck was carrying many toys to the toy store. as the truck drove, a little boy named tim saw it. tim loved to throw balls. he picked up a ball and threw it at the truck. the ball hit the truck and made a loud noise. the truck was very sad and stopped. tim felt bad for making the truck sad. he went to the truck and said sorry. the sleepy truck forgave tim. they became friends and played together. the truck was happy again and continued to the toy store.

one day, a boy named tim and his little brother sam were playing in the park. they were having so much fun. but then, sam started to feel upset. he missed their mom and dad. tim saw sam's sad face and asked, "why are you upset, sam?" sam said, "i miss mom and dad. i want to go home." tim knew what to do. he said, "let's pray and ask for help to feel better." so, tim and sam held hands and prayed. they asked for help to feel happy again. after they prayed, sam felt better. they played more and then went home to see their mom and dad. and they all felt happy together.

once upon a time, there was an amazing queen. she lived in a big, pretty castle. the queen had a magic power. she could melt things just by looking at them. one day, the sun was very hot. the queen went outside to play. she saw a big ice cream. she looked at the ice cream and it started to melt. the queen felt happy and ate the melted ice cream. but then, the queen felt too hot. she looked at her pretty castle and it started to melt too. the queen was sad. she could not live in her melted castle anymore. the amazing queen had to find a new home.

lily and tom are friends. they like to play together. one day, they find a yellow banana on the table. they want to eat it. "can i have the banana?" lily asks. "no, it is mine!" tom says. they both pull the banana. they pull and pull. the banana breaks in half. they are sad. "look what you did!" lily cries. "it is your fault!" tom shouts. they throw the banana pieces at each other. they are angry. they are not friends anymore. the banana is on the floor. it is brown and mushy. a dog comes and eats it. the dog is happy. lily and tom are not. the end.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named mia. mia had a favorite purple sweater. she wore it every day. she loved her sweater so much. one day, mia went to play with her friend, tim. tim saw mia's sweater and wanted it. he tried to poke mia to get the sweater. mia did not want to give her sweater away. they started to fight over the sweater. mia and tim pulled and tugged at the sweater. they did not stop. the sweater ripped in half. now, mia and tim were sad. they both lost the purple sweater, and they were not friends anymore.

once upon a time, there was a good cow. the cow had a big horn. one day, the cow went to play in the sun. the sun was hot and made the cow dry. the cow saw a big tree. the cow went under the tree to sit and rest. the cow's horn got stuck in the tree. the cow was sad and could not move. then, a little bird came and saw the cow. the bird wanted to help. the bird had a secret power. the bird touched the horn and the horn became small. the cow was free and happy. the cow and the bird became best friends.

one day, a little fish named fin wanted to swim in a garden. he asked his friend, bee, "can i swim in your garden?" bee said, "no, you can't swim in my garden. it is organized for bees, not fish." fin was sad. he wanted to swim in the garden, but he didn't want to make a mess. he thought and thought. then, he had an idea. he told bee, "i can help make your garden better for bees and fish. i can bring water for the flowers." bee agreed. fin swam in the garden and brought water for the flowers. the flowers grew big and strong. the garden was now a happy place for both fish and bees.

once there was a boy named tom. he had a radio. he liked to use the radio to listen to songs. one day, his friend tim came to play. tim saw the radio and said, "i want to use it too!" tom felt jealous. he did not want to share his radio. but he knew sharing was good. so, he said, "okay, tim. you can use it too." they both listened to the radio and danced. tom and tim had fun together. they were not jealous anymore. they learned to share and play together. they became best friends. and they always loved to use the radio to listen to songs and dance.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named sue. sue liked to clean her room. today, she found a big, tight knot in her toy rope. she tried to untie it, but it was very hard. sue felt sad. sue's mom came into the room and saw sue looking sad. "what's wrong, sue?" her mom asked. sue showed her mom the tight knot. "i can't untie it," she said with a frown. "don't worry," said her mom, "i can help you." together, they worked on the knot until it was untied. sue was happy again. after that, they cleaned the room together. sue learned that with a little help, even tight knots can be untied.

one day, a lively dog named max went to play outside. he saw a big ball and wanted to grab it. max ran fast and jumped high to get the ball. while playing, max met a new friend named sam. sam was a patient cat who liked to watch max play. max said, "sam, do you want to play with me and grab the ball?" sam smiled and said, "yes, max, i will play with you." max and sam played together all day. they took turns to grab the ball and run around. when they were tired, they sat under a tree and shared a big bowl of water. max and sam were happy to play and be friends.

once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big, harmless dog named max. max loved to play with his red ball. he would run and jump and catch it all day long. one day, max saw a circle on the ground. it was made of small stones. max thought it was a fun game, so he put his red ball in the circle. he wanted to prevent the ball from rolling away. max was a good dog. he kept the ball inside the circle and played all day. the people in the town were happy because max was a harmless dog who loved to play. and max was happy too, because he had his red ball and his circle.

once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a clever old man. he had a cane to help him walk. he liked to listen to the birds sing. one day, the old man went for a walk. he took his cane with him. as he walked, he listened to the birds. they made him happy. but then, the old man got lost. he could not find his way back home. he tried to listen for the birds, but they were gone. the old man was sad and scared. he sat down and cried, holding his cane.

once upon a time, there was a quiet pitch. on the pitch there were two kids. one was called tom and the other one was jack. tom said to jack, "what are you doing?" jack replied, "i'm trying to finish the pitch." tom asked, "what can i do to help you finish?" jack said, "you can stand here and be quiet." tom smiled and said, "ok!" so tom stood on the quiet pitch and watched as jack finished the pitch. when jack was finished, they both cheered!

once upon a time, there was a girl named lily. she had a job to deliver mail to all her friends. lily liked her job a lot. she would walk and say "hi" to her friends when she gave them their mail. one day, it started to rain. lily needed to keep the mail dry. she looked around and saw a big tree. the tree had a lot of big leaves. lily went under the tree to stay dry. the mail stayed dry too. after the rain stopped, lily went back to work. she delivered all the mail to her friends. they were happy to see her and their dry mail. lily felt good that she did her job well.

once upon a time, in a big green garden, there was a little orange caterpillar. the caterpillar was very hungry. he wanted to find some tasty leaves to eat. one day, the orange caterpillar saw a big green leaf. he was very happy! he entered the leaf and started to eat. the leaf was yummy and the caterpillar's tummy was full. after eating, the orange caterpillar was tired. he found a nice, cozy spot on a branch. he slept there for many days. when he woke up, he was not a caterpillar anymore. he was a beautiful butterfly!

one day, a boy named tim went to the park. he saw a big tree with a lot of fruit. tim wanted to eat the fruit, so he picked one. he took a bite and it was bitter. tim did not like it. he threw the fruit away. tim saw his friend sam at the park. he told sam about the bitter fruit. sam said, "i know how to make it sweet. we need juice!" they found some juice and spread it on the fruit. tim and sam took a bite of the fruit with juice. but it was still bitter. they did not like it. they were sad and went home. the fruit stayed bitter and they did not have a good day.

once upon a time, there was a chubby doll. the doll lived in a small house with a girl named lily. lily loved her doll very much. they played together every day. one day, the doll started to sneeze. "achoo! achoo!" the doll sneezed. lily was worried about her doll. she tried to make her feel better. she gave her doll a soft blanket and a warm hug. but the doll kept sneezing. "achoo! achoo!" the sneezes got bigger and bigger. lily didn't know what to do. she was very sad. the doll sneezed so much that it broke into pieces. lily cried because her chubby doll was gone. the end.

one day, a little boy named tim went to play outside. it was a hot day, and he saw a big hill near his house. tim wanted to test how fast he could run up the hill. so, he started to run. as tim ran up the hill, he met a girl named sue. sue said, "hi, tim! are you testing how fast you can run up the hill?" tim said, "yes, sue! it's a hot day, but i want to see how fast i can go." tim and sue raced to the top of the hill. they were both very fast. when they reached the top, they were tired but happy. they sat down and looked at the view. then, they ran back down the hill and went home.

once upon a time, there was a musician. he loved to play songs for everyone. he was very reliable. everyone liked him. one day, the musician lost his drum. he felt sad. he started to search for it. he looked in his house, in the park, and near the big tree. the musician found his drum near the big tree. he was so happy. he played a song for everyone. they all danced and had fun.

once upon a time, there was a pretty girl named lily. she loved to play outside with her friends. one sunny day, they all went to the park to play. while playing, lily saw a big tree. she wanted to lean on the tree and rest. but she didn't see the big rock near the tree. when she walked to the tree, she had a trip on the rock and fell down. her friends ran to help her stand up. lily learned that she should always look where she was going. she told her friends to be careful too. from that day on, they all looked where they were going and didn't trip anymore. and they played happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a big red truck. the truck had a job to spray water on hot things. the truck needed a license to do its job. the truck was very careful when it did its job. one day, the truck saw a small fire. the truck was ready to help. it sprayed water on the fire. the fire went away. the truck was happy it could help. the truck went back to its home. it was proud of its license. the truck knew it was careful and good at its job. everyone loved the big red truck.

once upon a time, in a hidden place, there lived a little fairy. she had tiny wings and a big smile. she loved to play and have fun. one day, the fairy wanted to test her new magic. she found a big tree and tried her magic on it. the tree turned into a big, colorful slide. the fairy was very happy. the little fairy played on the slide all day. she laughed and had a lot of fun. when the sun went down, the fairy used her magic again. the slide turned back into the tree. the happy fairy went home to sleep.

once upon a time, there was a big red ball. the ball loved to pass from one friend to another. one sunny day, the ball was with a fast rabbit and a slow turtle. the rabbit and the turtle wanted to play with the ball. the fast rabbit said, "let's pass the ball to each other!" the slow turtle agreed, and they started to play. they passed the ball back and forth, having lots of fun. as they played, the ball fell on the soil. the soil was soft and brown. the rabbit and the turtle picked up the ball and continued to pass it. they played all day, and the big red ball made them very happy.

one day, a little bird built a great nest in a big tree. the nest was made of sticks and leaves. the bird was very happy in its new home. a naughty cat saw the bird's nest and wanted to play with it. the cat climbed the tree and tried to slap the nest with its paw. the bird was scared and flew away. but the great nest did not fall. the cat got tired and went away. the little bird came back to its nest and was safe. the bird was very happy that its great nest was strong.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tom. tom was a regular boy who liked to play with his toys. one day, tom saw a big bug. the bug was so big that it was as big as tom's shoulder! tom wanted to be friends with the bug. he took a step closer to the bug and said, "hi, bug! my name is tom. will you be my friend?" the bug looked at tom and said, "yes, tom! i will be your friend. my name is big bug." tom and big bug played together every day. they took many steps together and had lots of fun. and they were the best of friends forever.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim loved to eat sweet things. one day, tim's mom made a smooth cake. tim was very happy. he wanted to eat the whole cake. his friend, sam, saw tim with the cake. sam said, "i recommend you eat a little bit. too much cake is not good for your stomach." but tim did not listen to sam. he ate the whole cake. he felt very bad. his stomach hurt a lot. tim's mom told him, "you should have listened to sam. he was right. now you have a big stomach ache." the moral of the story is to listen to your friends when they give you good advice.

once upon a time, there were two twins. they were nice and liked to play together. they had a ball they both loved. one day, a big boy came to play. he saw the ball and wanted it. so, he took the ball to steal it. the twins were sad. the twins went to the big boy and said, "please give our ball back." the big boy felt bad and gave the ball back. they all played together and had fun.

one day, a little girl named lily wanted to go on a vacation. she asked her mom, "can we go on a vacation, please?" her mom said, "yes, we can go to the beach!" at the beach, lily played in the soft sand. she made a big sand castle with her mom and dad. they had lots of fun. the sun was shining, and the water was nice and warm. after playing, lily asked her mom, "can we eat ice cream now?" her mom said, "yes, let's get some ice cream!" they all enjoyed their ice cream and had a great day on their vacation.

one day, a little dog named max was very excited. he saw a big ball in a tall tree. he wanted to play with the ball. he thought, "i need help to get the ball." max saw a big man with strong arms. the man saw max and the ball. the man wanted to help max. he reached up with his big palm and took the ball from the tree. max was so happy! he jumped and ran around the man. they played with the ball all day. max was very excited and glad that he got the help he needed.

once upon a time, there was a big boat. the boat liked to sail on the deep blue sea. one sunny day, the boat met a friendly tire floating on the water. "hi tire," said the boat. "do you want to sail with me on the deep blue sea?" "yes, i would like that," said the tire with a big smile. so, the boat and the tire sailed together on the deep blue sea. as they sailed, they saw many fish and birds. the boat and the tire became very good friends. they liked to sail together and have fun. and they lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim had a good watch. he loved his watch so much. it was red and shiny. he wore it all day long. one day, tim went outside to play. he jumped in the mud and had a lot of fun. but then, his watch got dirty. tim was sad. he wanted his watch to be clean and shiny again. tim went home and asked his mom for help. she said, "let's wash your watch!" so, tim and his mom washed the watch together. they used soap and water. they scrubbed the watch until it was clean and shiny again. tim was happy. he put on his good watch and promised to keep it clean.

once upon a time, there was a nice dog named bob. bob was a very reliable dog. he always helped his friends. one day, bob's friend, a cat named sam, was very hungry. sam wanted to eat spaghetti. bob wanted to help sam. so, he went to bring spaghetti for his friend. bob walked and walked until he found a big bowl of spaghetti. he carried it back to sam. sam was very happy to see the spaghetti. bob and sam ate the spaghetti together. they were both full and happy. from that day on, sam knew that bob was a very reliable friend. they played and had fun together every day.

once upon a time, there was a brown dog named buddy. buddy loved to play and run all day. he lived in a big park where he would meet many friends. one day, buddy found a big surprise. he saw a king sitting on a bench. the king had a shiny crown and a big smile. buddy was so happy to see the king in the park. buddy ran to the king and wagged his tail. the king laughed and petted buddy's soft fur. they played together all day. the king was so happy with buddy that he made him the king's best friend. from that day on, buddy and the king had many fun days together in the park.

one day, a little squirrel found a sweet acorn under a big tree. the squirrel did not know what it was, but it looked good to eat. the squirrel picked up the acorn and held it in its small hands. the squirrel showed the acorn to its friends, the birds and the rabbits. they all wanted to know what the sweet acorn tasted like. so, they all took a small bite. they liked it very much! after they ate the sweet acorn, they all played together in the sun. they were happy to know what an acorn was and that it tasted so good. they hoped to find more sweet acorns to share with their friends.

there once was a sweet little girl named lily. lily loved to play with her toy model car. it was her favorite toy. one day, lily's model car broke. she was very sad. lily went to her dad and said, "daddy, my car is broken. can you repair it, please?" her dad looked at the broken model car and smiled. "of course, lily. i will fix it for you," he said. lily's dad worked hard to repair the model car. when he was done, he gave it back to lily. she was so happy. "thank you, daddy!" she said. they played with the model car together and had a lot of fun.

one day, a little caterpillar was in the garden. he was very smelly. no one wanted to be near him. the caterpillar was sad. he wanted to have friends. then, a big bird saw the caterpillar. the bird wanted to eat him. but when the bird got close, he smelled the smelly caterpillar. the bird did not like the smell. he let the caterpillar go. the caterpillar was happy. he saw that being smelly was good. it helped him not get eaten by the bird. now, the caterpillar was not sad about being smelly. he knew that it was a good thing.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named mia. mia had a wish. she wanted to provide food for her cat, fluffy. fluffy was hungry, and mia was anxious to help her. mia asked her mom for help. her mom said, "let's go to the store and buy cat food." they walked to the store, holding hands. mia was very happy that her mom was helping her. at the store, they found cat food. mia picked it up and gave it to her mom. they went home, and mia provided the food to fluffy. fluffy was no longer hungry, and mia's wish came true. they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a small cat named mimi. mimi was very important to her family. she loved to play and make her family happy. one day, mimi saw a little bird who was sad. the bird had lost its way and could not find its mom. mimi wanted to help the bird. she knew it was important to comfort the sad bird. mimi and the bird went on a start of a new adventure. they looked for the bird's mom together. mimi made the bird feel safe and happy. soon, they found the bird's mom and they all became friends.

one day, a little boy named tim went for a walk with his mom. they walked by a big car. tim stopped and gazed at the car. "wow, look at that car, mom!" he said. the car was very big and shiny. tim's mom said, "yes, it is a nice car. but it is very cold outside. the wind is bitter." tim felt the cold wind on his face. he shivered and hugged his mom. they walked back to their warm house. tim said, "i liked the car, but i like being warm more." his mom smiled and hugged him tight. they were happy to be inside, away from the bitter wind.

one day, a boy named tim went to the store with his mom. they wanted to buy a toy. tim saw a ball that was light and easy to play with. he asked his mom, "can i have this ball, please?" his mom said, "let me see the price." she looked at the price and it was too high. tim was sad. they left the store without the ball. the next day, they went back to the store. this time, the price of the ball had dropped! it was now a good price. tim's mom said, "now we can buy the ball!" tim was so happy. they bought the ball and tim played with it all day long.

one day, a little boy named tim found a coin on the floor. he was happy and showed it to his friend, sam. sam looked troubled and said, "i don't know if we can keep it." "why not?" asked tim. "because it's not ours. we have to find who lost it," sam said. they went to their teacher and told her about the coin. the teacher smiled and said, "good job, boys. let's find the owner." in the end, they found the girl who lost the coin. she was so happy and thanked tim and sam. they felt good for doing the right thing.

once upon a time, in a big lake, there was a little alligator. the alligator liked to eat tasty things. he loved to swim and play with his friends. one day, the alligator saw a big, tasty cake. he wanted to eat it all. so, he took a big bite. then, something strange happened. the alligator started to become very big! his friends saw him and were scared. "don't be scared," said the alligator. "i am still your friend." they all played together and had fun. the alligator shared the tasty cake with his friends. they were all happy.

once upon a time, there was a poor girl named lily. she lived in a small house with her mom and dad. lily had a big, red ball that she loved to play with every day. one day, lily found a frog near the river. the frog told her, "if you give me a kiss, i will turn into a prince and we can have a marriage." lily thought about it and decided to give the frog a kiss. but, something unexpected happened! instead of the frog turning into a prince, lily turned into a frog too! now, they both could play and hop together in the river. and they lived happily ever after as two frog friends.

once upon a time, there was a big boat. the boat could sail on water. one day, the boat went on a trip to find a special chest. the boat sailed far away from home. the people on the boat saw many weird things. they saw big fish and birds with pretty colors. they were happy and excited to find the chest. after a long time, the boat found an island. the people looked for the chest on the island. they found it under a big tree. the chest was full of toys and treats. everyone was happy and they sailed back home. they played with the toys and shared the treats with their friends.

one day, a playful cat named tom found a pen on the floor. tom liked to watch the pen roll around. he would push the pen with his paw and watch it go fast. tom's friend, a dog named max, saw tom playing with the pen. max said, "tom, can i play with the pen too?" tom said, "yes, max! we can play together." tom and max took turns pushing the pen and watching it roll. they laughed and had a lot of fun. they played with the pen all day and became even better friends.

once upon a time, a girl named lucy went on a trip with her mom and dad. they went to a big house near the sea. lucy was very happy to play with the sand and the water. when they got to the house, lucy helped her mom unpack their bags. she found a small book called a passport. the passport had lucy's mom's name and picture in it. lucy thought it was a funny book. one day, lucy saw a flexible fish in the water. the fish could bend and move in all ways. lucy loved watching the fish play. she had a great time on her trip with her mom and dad.

one day, a little owl was in a tree. the owl was helpless. it could not fly. the owl saw a big bird. the big bird was strong. the owl said, "please help me. i cannot fly." the big bird said, "i can help you. i will lift you up." the big bird tried to lift the owl. but the owl was too heavy. the big bird could not lift the owl. the big bird was sad. the owl was sad too. a mean cat saw the helpless owl. the cat wanted to catch the owl. the big bird tried to stop the cat. they fought, but the cat was too strong. the cat caught the owl. the big bird was sad. the owl was gone.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named mia. she had a toy flute that she loved to play. one day, mia met an ugly frog near a pond. the frog looked sad. mia asked the frog, "why are you sad?" the frog said, "i am hurt and i need help to heal." mia wanted to help the frog feel better. mia played her flute for the frog. the music made the frog feel happy and helped him heal. the ugly frog became a beautiful friend. mia and the frog played together every day, and they were very happy.

once upon a time there was a girl called jane. jane was a very special girl, she liked to fix things. one day jane was looking for something to repair. she found her mom's blouse. it was very old and weird looking. jane decided to repair the blouse. she got her mom's sewing kit and she got to work. after a few hours of hard work, jane had fixed the blouse. it was perfect! her mom was so happy when she saw it. the blouse looked brand new again. jane was so proud of her work. she hugged her mom and they lived happily ever after.

one day, a funny dog named max saw a big lawn. max was very happy to see the lawn. he wanted to play on it. max entered the lawn and started to run. he ran very fast and jumped high. max was having a lot of fun on the lawn. soon, max saw a little girl. the girl laughed and clapped her hands. max and the girl played together on the lawn. they had a great day.

once upon a time, there was a tidy little house. in the house, there was a sink. the sink was very big and shiny. every day, a small duck would come to play in the sink. one day, the duck jumped into the sink. it started to splash water with its wings. the duck had so much fun. the water went up and down, and the duck laughed and splashed some more. after playing for a while, the duck got out of the sink. it shook its wings to dry off. the duck looked at the tidy little house and felt happy. it promised to come back and splash in the sink again soon.

one morning, a little girl named lucy woke up. the sun was shining and the birds were singing. lucy felt happy and excited for the day. lucy went to the kitchen to make a cake. she got a big bowl and put in some flour, sugar, and eggs. then, she used a spoon to stir, stir, stir. as she stirred, she sang a gentle song. when the cake was done, lucy shared it with her family. they all loved the cake and said "thank you!" lucy felt proud and happy. the morning was full of fun and yummy cake.

one day, a little girl named mia was eager to try something new. she saw her mom doing yoga in the living room. mia thought it looked fun, so she asked her mom if she could join. mia's mom said yes and showed her how to do a pose. they both stretched their legs and arms. mia tried to pull her arms up high like her mom. it was a little hard, but she kept trying. after a while, mia got better at yoga. she was happy to do it with her mom every day. they laughed and had fun together. mia was glad she tried something new and loved doing yoga with her mom.

once upon a time, there was a little duck named tim. tim lived near the sea. he loved to swim and play with his friends. one day, tim saw big waves. he wanted to surf on them like the big ducks. tim felt sad because he was too small to surf. he watched the big ducks surf on the waves. they were having so much fun. tim felt miserable because he could not join them. he wanted to surf too. then, a kind duck named sam saw tim. sam told tim to follow him. sam showed tim how to surf on little waves. tim was so happy. he followed sam and learned to surf. now, tim and sam surf together every day.

jane was very impatient. she wanted to write some words on the carpet. she went to ask her mom for a marker, but she said no. "you can't write on the carpet," mom said. jane was very sad. she wanted to write so badly! she waited and waited for her mom to change her mind. finally, mom said, "if you promise to be very careful, you can write on the carpet." jane was very happy. she took the marker and wrote some colorful words on the carpet. she was very proud of her work. no one was more patient than she was!

one day, a little girl named lily went to the park with her mom. lily saw a lovely red bird. the bird was looking for some food. lily wanted to help the bird. lily and her mom walked around the park. they found a big berry bush. the bush had lots of red and blue berries on it. lily picked some berries to give to the bird. lily went back to the bird and gave it the berries. the bird was very happy. it ate the berries and sang a pretty song. lily felt good because she helped the bird.

once upon a time, there was a young boy named tim. he loved to play and run in the park. one sunny day, tim saw a big tree with a seat under it. he was very happy to find a place to sit and rest. tim ran to the seat and leaned on it. but the seat was old and not strong. the seat started to shake and wobble. tim was scared, but he did not move away. suddenly, the seat broke and fell down. tim fell down too and hurt his leg. he cried and called for help. his mom came and hugged him. tim learned to be careful next time. the end.

once upon a time, there was a big house with a tall chimney. in this house lived a wealthy family. they had many toys and yummy food. they liked to play and laugh all day. one day, the family went outside to play. they saw a bird near the chimney. the bird was singing a pretty song. the family stood and watched the bird. they liked the song a lot. as they watched, the bird flew away. the family was happy they could see the bird by the chimney. they went back inside, feeling lucky. they played together and had a fun day.

once upon a time, there was a clown named bobo. bobo was a very dizzy clown. he loved to spin around and make the children laugh. one day, bobo met a big bear named benny. benny was sad because he was very heavy. bobo wanted to help benny. he said, "let's play together and you will not feel so heavy." so, they played and danced every day. benny started to weigh less and less. he was very happy with bobo. the children loved to watch bobo and benny play. they learned that helping others can make everyone happy. and bobo and benny were the best of friends forever.

once upon a time, there was an interesting mill. the mill was very big and pretty. it was in a happy town with many nice people. one day, a little girl named sue went to the mill. sue loved to imagine things. she imagined the mill was a big castle. she played and laughed with her friends. they had a lot of fun at the interesting mill. sue and her friends played all day. then, they went home to eat and sleep. they had a great day at the mill.

one day, a curious cat named tom saw a big red ball of yarn. he wanted to play with it. so, he used his paw to pull the yarn. as he pulled, the yarn started to make a long line on the floor. tom's friend, a little girl named sue, saw the cat playing with the yarn. she said, "tom, what are you doing?" tom just looked at her and kept pulling the yarn. sue had an idea. she took the yarn and made a pretty bow for her hair. she showed it to tom and said, "look, i made fashion with the yarn!" tom liked it and they both played with the yarn all day.

once upon a time, there was a group of animals in the woods. they were friends and liked to play together. one day, they decided to make a big pot of soup for everyone to share. the little mouse was very good at stirring the soup. he used a big spoon and stirred it round and round. the soup began to smell very yummy. the other animals watched and waited for the soup to be ready. while they were waiting, a fierce wind came and blew the soup away. the animals were sad, but they knew they could make more soup together. so they did, and they all enjoyed the warm soup on a windy day.

once upon a time, there was a big painter. he loved to paint all day. one day, he wanted to paint a big tree. he saw a little girl near the tree. the girl looked at the painter and said, "what are you doing?" the painter said, "i am painting this big tree." the little girl asked, "can i help you paint the tree?" the painter thought for a moment and then shrugged. "okay, you can help me paint the tree," he said. the little girl was very happy. together, they painted the big tree. it was a fun day. the big painter and the little girl became good friends. they loved to paint together.

once upon a time, there was a big amazing bridge. the bridge was over a deep blue river. many animals lived near the bridge and loved to play there. one sunny day, a happy frog named tim hopped to the bridge. tim wanted to dive into the river. he saw his friend, a little yellow duck named daisy, swimming in the water. tim jumped off the bridge and made a big splash. daisy and tim swam and played in the water all day. they had lots of fun under the amazing bridge. the end.

once upon a time, there was a big bear named ben. ben lived in the woods with his friends. one day, in the month of march, they decided to have a party. ben wanted to lend his toy car to his friend, tiny the squirrel. tiny was very happy and said "thank you, ben!" but, there was a rude fox named fred who wanted the toy car too. fred was jealous and tried to take the toy car away from tiny. ben saw this and said, "no, fred! that is rude!" fred felt sad and said sorry to tiny. they all played together and had a great party.

one day, a little bird named tim wanted to fly high in the sky. he saw a napkin on the ground. tim thought, "i can use this napkin to help me fly higher!" tim picked up the napkin with his beak. he started to fly. as he flew, the napkin helped him go higher and higher. tim was so happy. he felt like the most dependable bird in the sky. tim saw his friend, sam the squirrel, on a tree. sam said, "wow, tim! you are flying so high with that napkin!" tim replied, "yes, sam! i am a dependable bird now!" they both laughed and played together in the sky and the trees.

once upon a time, in a small town, there was a slow turtle named tim. tim loved to serve his friends. one day, tim found a bar of soap. he had an idea. tim went to his friend, a little duck named daisy. "daisy," he said, "i found some soap. let's play and make bubbles." daisy was happy to play with tim. they took the soap to the pond. tim served daisy by making bubbles with the soap. they laughed and had fun all day long. and that's how tim and daisy had a great bubble day.

once upon a time, there was a big ball. the ball was very big and very fun. a player named tim loved to play with the big ball. one day, tim went to play with his big ball. he saw a girl named sue. sue was sad. tim asked, "why are you sad, sue?" sue said, "i lost my ball." tim looked around and saw a small ball. he picked it up and gave it to sue. sue was happy. she said, "thank you, tim!" tim realized that sharing made him happy too. they played with the big ball and the small ball together. and they both had a very fun day.

once upon a time, in a small place, there was a little boy named tim. tim liked to touch everything he saw. he touched toys, trees, and even animals. one day, tim saw a big, round, and shiny thing. he wanted to touch it, but his mom said, "no, tim, that is rude. we don't touch things that are not ours." tim felt sad, but he knew his mom was right. later, tim found a soft and nice cat. the cat let tim touch its fur. tim was happy and learned that it is better to touch things with care and not be rude.

once upon a time, there was a clumsy big dog. he had very soft fur. the dog liked to play with a small ball. one day, the dog saw a box. he wanted to see what was inside. he used his paws to open the box. the box opened and it revealed many colorful balls. the dog was so happy. he played with the balls all day. his fur was covered in many colors. everyone laughed and played with the clumsy dog. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named sue. she was very adventurous. she loved to play outside and explore new places. one day, sue found a tiny cell in her backyard. it was a small hole in the ground. she was curious about what was inside. so, she knelt down to take a closer look. she saw some ants and a little bug in the cell. they were working together to carry food. sue was happy to watch the little bugs in the cell. she played with them every day. she learned that even small creatures can have big adventures. and that made sue very happy.

once upon a time, there was a girl named lily. lily had very long hair. she wanted a haircut to make her hair beautiful. one day, lily went to the hair shop. she asked for a haircut. the person cutting her hair was very nice and took care of her hair. lily was so happy. but then, something unexpected happened! a bird flew into the shop. the bird wanted a haircut too! the person cutting lily's hair gave the bird a beautiful haircut as well. now both lily and the bird had beautiful hair. they became friends and played together.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named mia. mia loved to play outside. one day, she saw a big tree with a pretty leaf. she wanted to get the leaf, but she was too small. mia was sad. mia saw a big, friendly dog. the dog was not careful, but mia had a plan. she asked the dog to get the leaf for her. the dog jumped high and got the leaf. mia was very happy. but then, mia let out a big yawn. she was very sleepy. when she woke up, she saw the leaf was gone. the dog had eaten it! mia was sad, but she laughed. she knew she could find another pretty leaf to keep.

one day, a big dog named max went to the park. max was hungry and wanted to eat some meat. he saw a man with a big bag. max thought the man would bring him meat. max went closer to the man. he sat down and looked at the man. the man felt uncomfortable. he did not know why max was looking at him. the man opened the bag and took out a ball. max was surprised. he did not expect a ball. max was happy with the ball. he forgot about the meat. the man threw the ball and max ran to catch it. they played together and had fun. max was not hungry anymore. the man and max became good friends.

once upon a time, there was a white cat. the cat liked to balance on things. one day, the cat saw a big ball. the cat wanted to balance on the ball. so, the cat jumped on the ball. as the cat balanced on the ball, it saw a bird. the bird was a pretty sight. the cat wanted to catch the bird. the cat tried to move on the ball to get closer to the bird. but, the cat did not know that the ball could roll. the ball rolled fast and the cat fell off. the bird flew away. the cat was sad but then it saw a butterfly. the cat forgot the bird and played with the butterfly. the cat was happy again.

once upon a time, there was a big yellow bird. the bird lived in a nice tree. the tree was in a pretty park. the bird liked to sing happy songs. when the bird sang, everyone felt peace. one day, a small boy came to the park. he was sad. the yellow bird wanted to help the boy. the bird thought, "i will send a happy song to the boy." so, the bird sang a fun song for the boy. the boy heard the song. he looked at the yellow bird. the boy started to smile. he felt peace in his heart. the boy and the bird became good friends. they played in the park every day. and they were happy together.

once upon a time, there was a huge bunny named bob. bob loved to skip and play in the sun. one day, he found a big green thing. it was broccoli! bob did not know what to do with the broccoli. he tried to skip with it, but it was too big. then, something unexpected happened. the broccoli started to talk to him! "hello, bob," said the broccoli. "i can help you skip better if you eat me." bob was scared but he ate the broccoli. and guess what? he could skip faster and higher than before! bob and the broccoli became best friends and skipped together every day.

one day, a big cat named tom went for a walk. he saw a church that was very organized. the church was big and had many pretty colors. tom liked the church a lot. tom walked into the church and saw many people. they were singing and clapping. tom wanted to join them, but he had to pause. he was shy, but the people looked nice. tom took a deep breath and started to sing with the people. they smiled at him and clapped. tom felt happy and loved the organized church. he made many friends that day.

once upon a time there was a big zip. everyone wanted to visit it because it was so impressive. so one day, two little friends, andy and will, decided to go and visit. they were so excited as they went. when they got there, it was more impressive than they ever imagined. it had a long line of people waiting to ride it. andy and will jumped in and the zip started to move. they laughed and waved as they went up and down. when the ride was over, andy and will were both so happy. they had so much fun visiting the zip. it was the best visit ever.

once upon a time, there was a tall tree. on the tree, there was a big cup. the cup was stuck in the tree. a little boy saw the cup and wanted to get it down. the boy tried to joke with the tree. he said, "tree, if you give me the cup, i will tell you a funny joke." the tree did not move. the boy tried to climb the tree, but he was too small. a tall man saw the boy and said, "i can help you get the cup." the man was very tall, so he reached up and got the cup down. the boy was happy and said, "thank you!" the man smiled and said, "you're welcome." they both laughed and shared the funny joke.

one day, a little boy named tim wanted to go to the library. he asked his big sister, jane, to take him there. jane was a reliable sister, so she said yes. they held hands and walked to the library together. at the library, they saw a friendly dog. the dog wagged its tail and looked happy. tim and jane decided to follow the dog. the dog led them to a big shelf full of colorful books. tim and jane picked out their favorite books and sat down to read. they were glad they followed the dog to the library. now they had fun books to read and a new friend to play with.

one day, a furry cat went for a walk. it found a big shell near the sea. the cat was very happy and played with the shell. then, something strange happened. a small crab appeared from the shell! the crab was scared of the furry cat. the cat was surprised too. but, they became friends. the cat and the crab played together every day. the furry cat thought the crab was a toy, but the crab was real. they had lots of fun and were happy.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she loved to play outside in the sun. one day, it was very hot, and lily's skin felt warm. she asked her mom, "can we play with water to cool down?" her mom said, "yes, let's use the spray bottle!" they filled the bottle with water and went outside. lily felt comfortable as the cool water sprayed on her skin. she laughed and sprayed her mom too. they played with the water spray all day long. lily and her mom had so much fun. they stayed cool and comfortable, even on the hot day. and they lived happily ever after.

once upon a time there was a young boy called nick. he was playing in his garden with his toy axe. he wanted to chop down the big tree in the garden. nick's mum saw him and said, "nick! what are you doing?" "i want to chop down the tree with my axe," nick replied. mum shook her head and said, "no, you are too young. you can't finish that with your axe. you need an adult to do it." nick frowned but he listened to his mum and put away his axe. later, dad finished chopping down the tree with his axe and nick clapped his hands. he was so happy to see the tree had gone!

once upon a time, there was a big, ugly tree. the tree had no friends. one day, a boy found a bulb. he wanted to add it to the ugly tree. the boy dug a hole near the tree and put the bulb in it. he covered the bulb with dirt. the boy was happy to add the bulb to the tree. after some time, the bulb grew into a beautiful flower. the ugly tree was happy too. now, the ugly tree had a pretty friend. they lived happily ever after.

one day, a boy named tim found a long paper. he wanted to print something fun on it. tim had an idea. he decided to print his thumb on the paper. tim dipped his thumb in blue paint. then, he pressed his thumb on the long paper. it made a pretty print! tim liked it a lot. he showed it to his mom and dad. they liked it too. tim printed more thumbs on the long paper. he used red, yellow, and green paint. the paper was full of colorful thumb prints. tim was very happy with his art. everyone loved tim's long paper with thumb prints.

once upon a time, in a lively green forest, there lived a happy bee. the bee had a hive high up in a tree. the bee loved to fly around and play in the sun with his friends. one day, the bee met a kind butterfly. the butterfly said, "hello, bee! i like your hive. it is very nice." the bee bowed and said, "thank you, butterfly. i like your pretty wings too!" they became good friends and played together every day. the forest was always full of fun and laughter. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a white cloud named fluffy. fluffy lived up in the sky. fluffy liked to let rain fall down on the ground. one day, fluffy saw a little girl named lily. lily was sad because her flowers were dry. fluffy wanted to help. so, fluffy let rain fall on lily's flowers. lily looked up at fluffy and said, "thank you for the rain, fluffy!" the flowers grew big and pretty. fluffy and lily became good friends. they played together every day.

once upon a time, there was a big pit. in the pit, there were many things that could match. there was a boy named tim who was very proud of his matching skills. one day, tim went to the pit to play. he saw a girl named sue. sue was trying to match some rocks. tim said, "i can help you match the rocks. i am very good at it." sue said, "yes, please!" tim and sue matched the rocks together. they were having so much fun. but, they did not see the big hole in the pit. they fell into the hole and could not get out. it was a bad ending for tim and sue.

once upon a time, there was a big, impressive cat named tom. he lived in a small house with a girl named sue. sue loved to eat and always asked tom to help her with her food order. one day, sue said to tom, "tom, can you help me finish my food order?" tom nodded and they both went to the kitchen. they found bread, cheese, and some fruit. tom helped sue put them on a plate. when they finished the food order, they sat down to eat. tom and sue shared the food and talked about their day. they were very happy and enjoyed their meal together. and they lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. lily loved to help her mom in the kitchen. one day, her mom said, "lily, can you wash the prunes?" lily said, "yes, mom!" and she went to wash the prunes. she tried to wash them, but it was difficult. the prunes were slippery and kept falling. lily was sad. she asked her mom, "mom, how do i wash the prunes?" her mom said, "hold them tight and be gentle." lily tried again. this time, she held the prunes tight and was gentle. she washed them all. lily was happy and her mom was proud. they had a fun time eating the prunes together.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim had a big cupboard in his room. he loved to open it and look at all the things inside. one day, tim found a big, sour lemon in the cupboard. he did not like sour things, but he thought the lemon was pretty. he put it on a table and looked at it. he liked to admire the bright yellow color. his mommy saw him looking at the lemon. she smiled and said, "tim, do you want to make lemonade?" tim was happy and said, "yes!" they made sweet lemonade together and drank it. tim was very proud of the lemon he found in the cupboard.

once upon a time, there was a hero named tim. tim was a very clean hero. he liked to help people and make them happy. one day, tim went to a park. he saw a little girl crying. she had lost her toy. tim wanted to help her. he closed his eyes and tried to imagine where the toy could be. tim looked under a tree and found the toy. the little girl was so happy! she hugged tim and said, "thank you, hero!" tim felt very happy too. he knew that being a clean hero was the best thing to be.

once upon a time, there was a big safari. in the safari, there were many animals. there was a big lion who was very dangerous. all the animals were scared of the lion. one day, a little rabbit had an idea. the rabbit told all the animals to bow to the lion. the rabbit said that if they bow, maybe the lion will be nice. all the animals agreed to try the rabbit's idea. the next day, all the animals went to the lion. they all bowed to the lion. the lion was surprised and happy. the lion decided to be nice to the animals. from that day, the safari was a happy place for all the animals.

once upon a time, there was a powerful girl named lily. she had a big book of stories. lily loved to read the stories to her friends. one day, lily found a story that she had not read before. she wanted to complete the story, so she started to read it out loud. her friends listened as she read the words. as lily read the story, her friends felt happy and strong. when she finished, they all clapped and said, "thank you, lily, for reading the powerful story to us!"

one day, a little girl named amy found a worm in her garden. the worm was long and available to play with. amy picked up the worm and said, "hi, worm! do you want to play with me?" the worm wiggled and seemed to say, "yes, let's play!" so, amy and the worm played in the garden all day. they made a small house for the worm out of leaves and sticks. at the end of the day, amy said, "worm, i had so much fun playing with you. i want to give you a kiss!" she kissed the worm gently and put him back in his new house. the worm wiggled happily, and they both knew they would play together again soon.

one day, a boy named tim went to the park. he saw his friend, sue, playing with a pen. tim wanted to play with the pen too. he asked sue, "can i play with your pen?" sue was patient and said, "yes, you can play with my pen after i finish." tim waited for sue to finish drawing. while they were waiting, a big dog came and took the pen. tim and sue were sad. tim and sue looked at each other and said, "we need to get the pen back!" they ran after the big dog. the dog dropped the pen and ran away. tim and sue were happy. they played with the pen together at the park.

one day, a little girl named amy went to her grandma's house. grandma had many old things. amy noticed a big, soft cushion on the couch. the cushion was old, but it was very pretty. it had a picture of a cat on it. amy picked up the old cushion and said, "grandma, i like this cushion. can i have it?" grandma smiled and said, "yes, dear. it was my favorite when i was a little girl too." amy hugged the old cushion and thanked her grandma. she took it home and put it on her bed. every night, amy would hug the cushion and think of her grandma. the old cushion made her feel happy and loved.

once upon a time, there was a beautiful bird. the bird had many colors. it liked to sing. one day, the bird found a penny. the bird was very happy. a boy saw the bird with the penny. the boy wanted the penny. he said, "give me the penny, bird!" but the bird did not want to give it. the bird flew away with the penny. the boy was angry. he found a stick. he said, "i will shoot the bird." the boy threw the stick at the bird. the stick hit the bird. the bird fell down. the penny fell too. the boy took the penny. he was happy. but the beautiful bird did not sing anymore.

once upon a time, there was a nice girl named ann. she had a small key. she believed the key could open a secret door. one day, ann went to the park. she saw a big tree with a small door. ann said, "i think my key can open this door." she put the key in the door and turned it. the door opened! inside the tree, ann found a nice cat. the cat said, "thank you for opening the door. i was stuck in here." ann and the cat became friends and played in the park all day. they were very happy.

once upon a time, in a small town, there was a store. the store was old and needed help. a kind man wanted to restore the store and make it beautiful again. the kind man worked hard every day. he painted the store with bright colors. he fixed the broken windows and doors. the store started to look beautiful again. the people in the town were happy. they came to the store to buy things. the store was the most beautiful place in town. the kind man and the people lived happily ever after.

one day, a wise dog named max went for a walk. he saw many cars and big trucks on the road. this was traffic. max wanted to cross the road, but he knew he needed to be careful. max saw a little girl named lily standing near the road. she wanted to cross too. max said, "hi, i'm max. i can help you cross the road." lily smiled and said, "thank you, max." max looked both ways and saw a big truck coming. he told lily, "wait! it's not safe." they waited for the traffic to stop. when it was safe, max said, "now we can go!" they crossed the road together, and max was happy to help his new friend.

once upon a time, there was a little bird named tim. tim loved to sing songs all day long. one day, it seemed very cold outside. the wind was icy, and tim's feathers were not warm enough. tim saw a big bear named ben. ben was very big and warm. tim wanted to be friends with ben. he sang a nice song to ben. ben liked the song and became friends with tim. now, tim and ben were friends, they helped each other. tim sang songs to make ben happy, and ben helped tim stay warm in the icy weather. the moral of the story is that we should help each other and be good friends.

one day, a girl named sue found some chalk. she saw a smooth wall and wanted to draw. sue made a big, nice sun with the yellow chalk. she was very happy. sue's friend, tom, came to see her. he saw her sun and said, "wow! i want to draw too!" tom took the chalk and drew a car. sue liked the car and wanted to drive it. then, something unexpected happened! the car began to move on the wall. sue and tom were so surprised. they jumped into the car and drove it on the smooth wall, having fun together.

one day, a cat and a dog were playing in the sun. they were very glad to be friends. the cat said, "i am glad to play with you." the dog said, "me too! we have fun." then, a big bird came down from the sky. the cat and the dog were scared. the bird said, "do not be scared. i am a nice bird. i want to be your friend too." the cat, the dog, and the bird played all day. they were very glad to be friends. the big bird was not scary. they all had fun together. and from that day, they were always happy to play together.

once upon a time, there was a little dog named spot. spot liked to play with his ball. one day, spot saw a stand where a nice man was selling balls. spot wanted a new ball to play with. spot went to the stand and said, "i want a ball, please." the nice man said, "you must wait. i am helping others right now." spot was patient and waited for his turn. when it was spot's turn, he said, "i demand a ball now." the nice man gave spot a new ball. spot was very happy and went to play with his new ball. he learned that being patient and asking for what he wanted was a good way to get things.

once upon a time, there were two friends named sam and kate. sam had a strong, yellow jump rope and kate loved to dance. one day, sam said, "let's play a game!" and kate smiled and said, "yes!". sam said, "let's do the jump rope dance. i'll step in and out of it while you spin it around." kate clapped her hands and said, "yes, let's do it!". then, she grabbed the strong, yellow jump rope and started spinning it. sam stepped in and out, back and forth. the two friends laughed and played until the sun set. at the end, sam said, "that was so much fun!" and kate said, "yes! let's do it again!"
