once upon a time, a little dog named spot lived in a big house. spot's owner was a rich man. he gave spot a long leash to play outside. one day, spot saw a little girl named lily. she was playing with a ball. spot wanted to play too. he ran to lily with his long leash. lily was surprised and said, "oh! hi, spot! do you want to play with me?" "yes, let's play!" said spot. they played with the ball all day. spot was very happy. in the end, they were both tired but had a lot of fun. spot and lily became best friends.

once upon a time, there was a gifted cat named luna. she could polish things very well. one day, she found a bottle of poison. luna knew it was bad and should not touch it. luna went to her friend, a wise old owl named oliver. she told him, "oliver, i found poison. what should i do?" oliver said, "luna, you are gifted at polishing. polish the bottle until it is very clean. then, we will hide it where no one can find it." luna polished the bottle until it shined. she and oliver hid it in a secret place. they knew they did a good job. luna and oliver were happy that they kept everyone safe.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named mia. mia had a toy passport. she loved to play with her passport all day. one day, it started to rain outside. mia's mom said, "mia, we can't go out today because it's raining." mia felt sad and weak because she wanted to play outside. mia had an idea. she said, "mom, can we play with my passport inside?" her mom smiled and said, "yes, mia. let's pretend we are going on a trip." they played and had fun even though it was raining outside.

once upon a time, there was a big, healthy dog named max. max loved to play near the water with his friend, a little boat. the boat was red and shiny. one day, max and the boat went to the water to play. the boat would tease max by going fast and far away. max would laugh and say, "come back, boat! i want to play too!" the boat would come back, and max would jump in and swim with it. after playing and splashing in the water, max and the boat would rest on the shore. they were happy friends who loved to play together. and they lived happily ever after.

one day, a brave boy named tim went on a walk. he saw a big hill with a top. tim wanted to go to the top of the hill. he started to walk up the hill. tim was very happy. when tim was near the top, he saw a big box. the box had a note. the note said, "this box includes something fun!" tim was excited. he opened the box to see what was inside. inside the box, tim found a big, red ball. he was surprised. tim said, "wow, i did not think i would find a ball here!" he took the ball and played with it all day. tim was very happy that he was brave and went to the top of the hill.

once upon a time, there was a sweet dog named spot. spot liked to spend his days playing in the park. he would run, jump, and roll in the grass. spot was very happy. one day, spot saw a girl named jane. jane was on a jog in the park. spot wanted to play with jane, so he ran up to her. jane saw spot and smiled. jane and spot spent the day together. they jogged and played in the park. they had a lot of fun. at the end of the day, jane gave spot a big hug. spot was very happy to have a new friend.

once upon a time, there was a lonely boy named tim. he lived in a big house with a big elevator. tim loved to collect toys. he had many toys, but he still felt lonely. one day, tim met a girl named sue. sue also loved to collect toys. she asked tim, "do you want to play with me and share your toys?" tim said, "yes, i would love to play with you!" tim and sue played together with their toys in the big house. they took the elevator to go up and down. they were very happy. now, tim was not lonely anymore. they became best friends and collected toys together forever.

once upon a time, there was a king. the king had a big, shiny crown. it was very tight on his head. he wanted to find a new crown that was not tight. one day, the king met a nice man who made things. the king asked the man to make a new crown for him. the man said yes, and he started to work. the king was very happy. after some time, the man finished the new crown. the king put it on his head. it was not tight! the king was so happy. he thanked the man and wore his new crown every day. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, a girl named lily went to visit her grandma. grandma was busy in her kitchen. she was making jam. lily loved her grandma's jam. it was sweet and yummy. while they were making jam, they heard a loud noise. it was a big cat. the cat was hungry. it wanted to eat the jam. lily and grandma were scared. but then, something unexpected happened. the cat didn't eat the jam. instead, it helped lily and grandma make more jam. they all became friends and had a fun day together. the cat was not so scary after all.

once upon a time, there was a silly little bug. this bug was only an inch long. it was a foolish bug, always making mistakes. one day, the bug wanted to send a letter to his friend. he wrote the letter and put it in a box. but the foolish bug forgot to put a stamp on the box. the mailman came and saw the box. he knew the bug made a mistake. the mailman put a stamp on the box and sent it to the bug's friend. the friend got the letter and smiled. the bug may be foolish, but he had a good friend in the mailman. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a gifted dog named spot. spot was very good at finding things. one day, he found a big book with many pages. spot played with the book and accidentally destroyed one page. he felt sad because he knew the book was important. spot's owner saw the book and said, "it's okay, spot. you are still a gifted dog." they gave spot a hug and fixed the page together. spot was happy and promised to be more careful next time.

once upon a time, there was a boy named mark. mark had a big piece of cardboard. he liked to play with it. it was mild outside, so he took the cardboard and went to the park. at the park, mark saw a hill. he wanted to slide down the hill on his cardboard. he put the cardboard on the grass and sat on it. then, he slid down the hill. it was so much fun! mark played on the hill with his cardboard all day. his friends joined him too. they all had a great time sliding down the hill. when it was time to go home, mark was happy. he loved his day at the park with his cardboard.

once upon a time, there was a big bin. the bin was a little bit crazy. it liked to dance and sing all day long. the bin had many friends. one day, the bin met a new friend. the new friend was a ruler. the ruler and the bin played together. they had so much fun! the ruler said, "i can measure things. do you want to see?" the bin said, "yes, please!" so, the ruler measured the bin. the bin was very tall. the bin and the ruler played together every day. they measured things all around them. they measured big things and small things. they had a great time. and they were the best of friends.

once upon a time, there was a little puppy named spot. spot loved to play and run around in the yard. one day, spot saw a big red ball. he ran to the ball and started to play with it. as spot was playing, he heard a ring. it was the doorbell. spot ran to the door and saw a little girl named amy. amy said, "hi, puppy! do you want to play with me?" spot wagged his tail and barked happily. amy and spot played all day. they ran, jumped, and had a lot of fun. when it was time to eat, amy's mom gave them some delicious treats. spot loved the treats, and he knew he had found a new best friend.

one day, a cop named tom wanted to bake a cake. he put on his apron and got out all the things he needed. he was very excited to make the cake. but tom was a bit careless. he put too much flour and not enough sugar in the cake. when he mixed it all together, it looked very strange. he put the cake in the oven and crossed his fingers. when the cake was done, tom took it out of the oven. it did not look like a cake at all. it was flat and not sweet. tom was sad, but he knew he could try again. next time, he would be more careful and make the best cake ever.

once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named max. max loved to lead his little girl, amy, to the big park. they played and had fun every day. one day, max and amy found a muffin on the ground. "look, max! a muffin!" said amy. max sniffed the muffin, but he didn't eat it. he knew it was not for him. amy put the muffin in her bag, and they went to play. later, a hungry bird came to the park. amy remembered the muffin in her bag. "here, bird! have the muffin!" she said. the bird ate the muffin and was very happy. max and amy smiled, knowing they had done a good thing.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim was a fine boy who liked to help his mom. one day, his mom wanted to go to the grocery store. tim wanted to go with her to help. at the grocery store, tim and his mom picked up many things. they got apples, bananas, and bread. tim wanted to help, so he put the groceries in the cart. he was happy to be a big helper. after they bought all the groceries, tim and his mom went home. tim helped put the groceries away. his mom was very proud of him. they had a fun day at the grocery store together.

once upon a time, there was a unique little bird named tim. tim was not like other birds. he had a special gift. he could fill things up with his beak. one day, tim saw a big hole in the ground. the hole needed to be filled, so tim decided to help. he picked up dirt with his beak and dropped it into the hole. he did this many times. after a while, the hole was full. tim felt very happy with his success. all the other birds cheered for him. tim knew that he was unique, and he was proud to use his special gift to help others.

once upon a time, a little boy named tim found a smooth rock. he liked the rock very much. he took it home and put it on his table. the next day, tim woke up and saw that the rock had moved an inch! he was confused. he asked his mom, "did you move my rock?" his mom said, "no, i did not." tim was very surprised. that night, tim watched his rock. he saw it step and move an inch again! the rock was alive! tim and the rock became best friends. they played together every day. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim had a toy that he loved very much. it was a ball with a buckle on it. he played with it all day long. one day, tim saw a big tree that was very far away. he wanted to strike the ball at the tree. so, he threw the ball as hard as he could. the ball went up, up, up in the sky. but it did not come back down. tim was very sad. he looked for his ball everywhere, but he could not find it. he knew that the tree was very far away, but he did not think that his ball would be lost forever. now, tim had no ball to play with.

once upon a time, there was a humble goat named billy. billy had a big horn on his head. he loved to play with his friends in the green field. one day, billy and his friends were playing near a fence. billy got his horn stuck in the fence. he tried to pull it out, but it was stuck tight. his friends tried to help, but they could not get it out either. billy's mom came to help. she had an idea. she took a small tool and cut the part of the fence that was stuck to billy's horn. with a little more help from his friends, billy was free again. they all cheered and went back to playing in the field.

once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named max. max was a very good dog. he always wanted to help his friends. one day, max and his friends went to play in the park. in the park, max saw a toy gun. max wanted to play with the gun. he picked it up with his mouth and brought it to his friends. max's friends were happy to see the toy gun. they all took turns playing with it. after playing with the gun, max and his friends went back home. max was very loyal and always wanted to help his friends. they all had a fun day at the park.

once upon a time, there was an enormous dog named max. max had a big itch on his back. he tried to scratch it, but his legs were too short. one day, max saw a cat named lily. lily was very good at scratching her itches. max asked lily for help. "can you help me with my itch, please?" max said. lily agreed to help max. they became good friends. max and lily played a game called "match." they matched different toys and colors. max was very happy. his itch was gone, and he had a new friend. they played and laughed all day long.

anna loves to play soccer with her friends. she likes to run, kick and score goals. sometimes she gets dirty and sweaty from playing. then she needs to bathe. anna's mom is reliable. she always helps anna to bathe after soccer. she fills the tub with warm water and bubbles. she gives anna a soft towel and a clean dress. she sings to anna while she washes her hair. anna feels happy and cozy after her bath. she hugs her mom and says thank you. she puts on her dress and brushes her teeth. she is ready for bed. she dreams of scoring more goals tomorrow.

once upon a time, there was a cheerful frog named hopper. hopper lived in a swamp with his family. they liked to play and jump all day long. one day, hopper met a big fish that lived in the swamp too. the fish was not cheerful. he was sad because he could not jump like hopper and his family. hopper wanted to help the fish be happy. hopper had an idea. he told the fish to quit being sad and try to jump. the fish tried to jump and he did it! the fish was happy and became hopper's friend. now, they all played and jumped together in the swamp.

once upon a time, a boy named tim had a hurt leg. he could not run and play with his friends. tim was sad. one day, a modern doctor came to his side. the doctor said, "i can heal your leg, tim." tim was happy. the doctor put a magic band on his leg. "this will heal your leg," said the doctor. tim waited for his leg to heal. he wanted to play with his friends. but the magic band did not work. tim's leg did not heal. the doctor was sad too. tim could not play with his friends. and they all lived with a bad ending.

one day, a little mole was feeling restless. he wanted to go out and play. but his mom said, "no, you must stay in and help me clean the house." the little mole was sad but he helped his mom. while they were cleaning, the little mole found a big rock. he pushed the rock and it moved. behind the rock, there was a secret door. the little mole was surprised! he called his mom to see the door. they opened the door and found a big room full of toys! the little mole and his mom were so happy. they played with the toys all day. the little mole thanked his mom for letting him help her clean.

once upon a time, there was a little ant. the ant was very good at finding food. he was a successful ant. he loved to move and explore new places. one day, he went on a big adventure. the sun was hot, and the ant was tired. he saw a big tree with lots of shade. he thought, "i will go to the shade and rest." so, he moved to the tree and sat in the shade. it was nice and cool under the tree. after resting, the ant was ready to go home. he moved all the way back to his ant hill. he told all his ant friends about the shade under the tree. they were all happy to hear about the cool place to rest.

once upon a time, there was a sweet little dog named sam. sam had four soft paws that he loved to run on. one day, sam found a pretty ribbon on the ground. sam wanted to tie the ribbon on his paw, but he did not know how. he tried and tried, but he could not do it. sam felt sad and sat down under a big tree. just then, a kind bird saw sam and flew down to help. the bird used her beak to tie the ribbon on sam's paw. sam was so happy and thanked the bird. they became good friends and played together every day.

once upon a time, there was a big mop. the mop was very heavy. it was hard for the mop to move around. but the mop was happy because it could help clean the house. one day, the mop wanted to fill a bucket with water. it went to the sink and turned on the water. the water went into the bucket. the mop was happy because it could clean even better with water. the mop went to the living room and started to clean the floor. the heavy mop moved slowly, but it did a great job. the floor was very clean when the mop was done. the mop was proud of its work and knew it was a helpful friend in the house.

once upon a time, there was a little dog named ben. ben was very impatient. he always wanted things right away. one day, ben's mom said, "ben, you need to learn to wait." ben did not want to learn. he just wanted his snack. but his mom said, "if you learn to wait, you can have a snack." ben thought about it. he decided to try. he sat down and waited. it was not easy. but he tried very hard. after a while, ben's mom gave him a snack. it was a big, yummy bone. ben was so happy! he learned that waiting can be good. and he was not so impatient anymore.

once upon a time, there was a little human named tim. tim loved to play and have fun. one day, tim wanted to pretend to be a fancy king. so, he put on a fancy hat and a fancy cape. tim walked around his house, pretending to be the fancy king. he told his toys what to do, just like a king would do. he made a big castle out of blocks and sat on his toy chair like it was a throne. at the end of the day, tim was tired from being a fancy king. he took off his hat and cape and went to bed. tim had a big smile on his face because he had so much fun pretending to be a fancy king.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim loved to eat toast for breakfast every day. one day, a big storm came to tim's town. the storm was very strong and destroyed many things. tim was sad because the storm destroyed his toaster. now he could not make toast for breakfast. he felt very hungry and missed his toast. his mom saw how sad tim was and had an idea. she took tim to the store and they bought a new toaster. tim was so happy! the next day, tim made toast again. he said, "even though the storm was bad, now we have a new toaster and my toast is not dead!"

one day, a nosy cat named tom went to the opera. he wanted to see the show. tom sat in the big chair and looked around. people were talking and laughing. tom heard a man say, "we need a singer for the show!" tom thought, "i can sing!" he jumped on the stage and said, "i can sing for the show!" the people looked at tom, surprised. the man said, "okay, let's hear you sing." tom sang a loud and funny song. the people laughed and clapped. tom was happy. the show went on with tom as the star. and that's how the nosy cat became an opera singer.

one day, there were two cops in the park. everyone thought they were popular because they were cops. the cops remained in the park for a few hours and then left again. after that, the kids stayed in the park to play. they liked it because the park remained safe since the cops were there. the kids had a good time and still remember the popular cops.

once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a small house. in the house lived a man. the man was very nice. he had a big dog. the dog was enormous. one day, the man and the dog went for a walk. they saw a big cat. the cat was not nice. the cat wanted to play, but it played too rough. the dog was scared of the cat. the dog screamed. the man heard the scream. he ran to help his dog. the man saw the cat and said, "no, cat! you can't play like that!" the cat stopped playing rough. the man, the dog, and the cat became friends. they all played together, but the cat learned to play nice.

once upon a time, there was a team of three friends. they were playing with their toys in the park. one friend was very bossy. he always told the others what to do. one day, the bossy friend said, "let's destroy the sand castle!" the other two friends did not want to, but the bossy friend made them do it. they all kicked the sand castle and it fell down. the next day, the two friends decided to tell the bossy friend that they did not like to destroy things. they wanted to play nice games. the bossy friend said sorry and promised to be nice. from that day on, the team played happily together.

once upon a time, there was a little brown dog. the dog liked to play and run. the dog had a big, happy smile. one day, the dog found popcorn on the ground. the dog started to eat the popcorn. the popcorn was yummy and the dog was happy. the little brown dog ate all the popcorn. after eating, the dog ran and played some more. the dog had a great day.

one day, a little lizard was in the sun. he was very happy. the lizard was green and adorable. he liked to play with his friends. but then, he saw a big bird. the bird was not nice. the little lizard was scared. he started to tremble. he did not want the bird to get him. the little lizard ran to a tree. he climbed up high. the big bird could not get him there. the little lizard was safe. his friends came to help him. they all played together again.

once upon a time, there was a person named tom. tom loved to ride his bike every day. he would ride his bike to the park, to the store, and to visit his friends. one day, tom saw a yummy cake in the window of a bakery. he really wanted to eat it, but he did not have any money. tom thought about taking the cake without paying, but he knew that was wrong. tom decided to do something nice for the bakery. he helped clean the bakery and in return, the baker gave him a yummy cake. tom learned that doing good things for others can bring happiness and yummy treats.

one day, a clever girl named lily wanted to buy a toy. she asked her mom to take her to the toy store. they had to ride the subway to get there. lily was very excited to go on the subway and see all the people. when they got to the toy store, lily saw many toys. she saw dolls, cars, and balls. lily wanted to buy a big, red ball. her mom said yes, and they went to pay for the ball. after they bought the ball, lily and her mom went back to the subway. they rode the subway home, and lily played with her new ball all day. she was very happy and had a lot of fun.

once upon a time, in a small town, there was a famous show. the show had many fun things to display. the people in the town loved to go and see it. the show had special equipment to make it fun. there were big balloons, funny hats, and yummy treats. the kids in the town were very happy to play with the equipment. one day, a little girl named lucy went to the famous show with her mom and dad. she saw the pretty display and played with the fun equipment. lucy had the best day ever at the famous show with her family.

one day, a funny cat named tom saw a big post. he wanted to play with it. he tried to push it, but it did not move. tom was sad. tom had an idea. he asked his friend, a strong dog named max, to help him. max said, "i will help you, tom." they both tried to push the post. it still did not move. they were very sad. then, they saw a big stick. max said, "let's stir the post with the stick." they used the stick to stir the post. the post finally moved! tom and max were very happy. they played with the post all day.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim was troubled because he wanted to make a trophy for his friend, sam. sam was nice and always helped tim when he needed it. tim found some things to make the trophy. he got a cup, some shiny paper, and glue. tim put the shiny paper on the cup and it looked good. he was happy with his trophy. tim gave the trophy to sam, and sam was very happy. they played and laughed all day. tim was not troubled anymore, and they were the best friends ever.

once upon a time, in a big tree, there was a jolly owl. his name was ollie. ollie loved to play with his friends in the forest. they would laugh and have fun all day. one day, ollie and his friends were playing hide and seek. ollie hid in a small hole in the tree. his friend, bunny, found him and said, "i see you, ollie! you cannot escape!" ollie laughed and said, "you got me, bunny! let's play again!" they played more games and had a great day. the jolly owl and his friends were very happy.

once upon a time, there was a clean cat with soft fur. the cat liked to twist and play all day. one day, the cat met a dog in the park. the dog had dirty fur and did not like to twist. "let's twist and play!" said the cat to the dog. but the dog did not want to play. he was too tired and wanted to sleep. this made the cat sad. the cat thought of a plan to make the dog twist and play. she found a big ball and rolled it to the dog. the dog saw the ball and started to twist and play with the cat. they both had a fun day and became good friends.

jeff and hazel were best friends. they loved playing together every day. one day, hazel wanted to play on jeff's new brown yacht. jeff said no. hazel got really mad and said, "i don't want to be your friend anymore!" jeff felt very sad. then, the next day hazel came to play again. jeff said, "i'm sorry for not letting you play on the yacht, can you forgive me?" hazel said, "yes, i forgive you!" they hugged each other and then started playing together. they had lots of fun, and they were best friends again. the end.

once upon a time, there was a big lake. the lake was very interesting. many animals lived near the lake. one day, a duck and a frog met at the lake. the duck said to the frog, "i admire the lake. it is so pretty." the frog agreed, "yes, the lake is very nice." they played together in the lake. they swam and jumped. they had a lot of fun. they became good friends. the duck and the frog loved the interesting lake.

one day, a little girl named sue found a pretty ornament. it was round and shiny. she wanted to show it to her friend, tom. sue put the ornament on a stand in her room so it would not fall. tom came to sue's house to play. sue said, "look at my pretty ornament!" tom looked at it and smiled. but then, he touched the ornament and it fell off the stand. it broke into many pieces. sue was sad and ashamed. she cried, "why did you break my ornament?" tom felt bad and said, "i am sorry, sue." but the ornament could not be fixed. sue and tom were both very sad.

once upon a time, there was a parrot named polly. polly lived in a big tree. the tree was in a big park. the park was always full of kids playing. one day, polly saw an empty box under her tree. she wanted to see what was inside. polly flew down to the box. but the box was empty. polly felt sad. then, polly heard some kids coming. the kids were happy. they were going to celebrate a birthday. they brought a big cake and many balloons. polly flew to the kids and they all played together. they celebrated the birthday and everyone was happy.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tom. tom liked to have fun. he had a camera. the camera was light. tom took the camera everywhere. one day, tom went to the park. he saw a big tree. tom wanted to take a photo of the tree. he climbed up the tree with his light camera. he was very high. tom took a photo of the tree. but then, he lost his grip. tom fell down from the tree with his camera. the camera broke. tom was sad. the end.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she loved to help her mom in the kitchen. one day, her mom asked her to add some salt to the soup. "be careful, lily," her mom said. "the salt jar is fragile. it can break." lily held the jar with her tiny hands. she put some salt in the soup, just like her mom asked. "good job," her mom said with a smile. they both tasted the soup. it was yummy! lily was happy to help her mom. they had a fun day in the kitchen together.

once upon a time, there was a big horse. the horse was very frightened. it did not like loud sounds. one day, a little girl named sue found the horse. sue wanted to help the horse not be scared. sue was very nice to the horse. she gave the horse food and water. she talked to the horse in a soft voice. the horse started to feel better. the horse knew sue valued it. sue and the horse became best friends. they played together every day. the horse was not frightened anymore. sue and the horse were very happy. they loved each other very much.

once upon a time, there was an old bell. the old bell loved to ring. it rang every day in a big tower. one sunny day, a little boy named tim made a sandwich. it was a yummy sandwich with cheese and bread. tim wanted to eat the sandwich under the big tower. as tim sat under the tower, the old bell rang. the sandwich fell on the ground. tim was sad. but then, a friendly dog came and ate the sandwich. tim and the dog became best friends. they played together every day under the big tower, listening to the old bell ring.

once upon a time, there was a small bell. the small bell loved to ring. it lived at the top of a long stair. one day, a big wind came. the wind blew the small bell down the stair. the small bell was sad. it wanted to go back up the stair and ring again. a nice cat saw the small bell. the cat helped the small bell go back up the stair. the small bell was happy. it rang loud and clear. the cat and the small bell were friends. they played together every day.

once upon a time, there was a funny flower. this flower lived in an office. every day, the flower would bloom and make the office pretty. one day, a little girl came into the office. she saw the funny flower and said, "hello! you are a funny flower. i like how you bloom and make the office pretty." the funny flower was happy to hear this. it bloomed even more to make the little girl smile. they became good friends and played together in the office every day. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a big mountain. the mountain was very tall and strong. many animals lived on the mountain. they were happy and played all day. one day, it started to rain. the rain made the mountain wet. the animals did not like the wet mountain, so they went to find a dry place to play. a big, strong wind came and tried to destroy the mountain. it blew and blew, but the mountain was too strong. the wind could not destroy the mountain. the animals were happy that their home was safe. they went back to the mountain and played again. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a healthy girl named lily. she loved to play outside and write in her journal. every day, she would write about her fun adventures in the park. one sunny day, lily went to the park with her journal. she saw a big ice cream cone on the ground. it was starting to melt in the sun. lily thought it would be fun to write about the melting ice cream in her journal. but as she wrote, the ice cream melted more and more. soon, it was all gone. lily was sad. she wanted to eat the ice cream, but now she could not. the end.

one day, a little boy named tim went to a big hall with his mom. the hall was full of people. they were all there for a party. tim felt very alert because he saw so many colorful balloons and bright lights. tim saw a big table with lots of food. he asked his mom, "can i taste the cake, please?" his mom said, "yes, but just a small piece." tim took a small piece of cake and it tasted very sweet and yummy. tim and his mom played games and danced in the hall. they had so much fun. at the end of the party, tim was very tired but happy. they went home with a big smile on their faces.

once upon a time, there was a big, thick boat. it was a very nice boat. one day, a boy and his dog went on the boat. they wanted to have fun on the water. as they rode the boat, they saw a big box in the water. the boy and his dog were very surprised! they pulled the box onto the boat. they wanted to see what was inside. when they opened the box, they found a lot of fun toys! they played with the toys all day. at the end of the day, the boy and his dog were very happy. they had a great day on the boat with their new toys.
