once upon a time, there was a generous girl named lily. lily loved to clap and sing. one day, she found a passport under her bed. she did not know what it was, but she thought it was pretty. lily took the passport to her friend, tom. tom saw the passport and said, "wow! this is a passport! you can use it to go to other places." lily and tom decided to play a game. they pretended to use the passport to go on a big trip. they clapped and danced as they imagined all the fun places they could visit. they had a great time playing together with the passport.

one day, a boy named tim found a toy that could shoot. it was a fun toy. tim liked to play with it. he would shoot at things in his room. he would shoot at any object he could see. tim's mom said, "only shoot at things that are safe." tim listened to his mom. he only shot at things that were not breakable. he shot at his soft toys and pillows. he did not shoot at the glass or the tv. tim played with his toy all day. he was happy to have it. he used all the available toys to shoot at. tim had a great day with his new toy.

once upon a time, there was a little soldier. he was pale and small. he lived in a box. one day, a girl named lucy came to unpack the box. the soldier was happy to be out. but there was a problem. the soldier's hat was missing. the pale soldier and lucy looked for the hat. they looked under the bed and in the closet. they found the hat behind a big toy. the soldier put on his hat and was happy again. and they played together all day long.

once upon a time, there was a girl named mia. mia was an adventurous girl who liked to explore. one sunny day, mia went for a walk in the woods with her mom and dad. in the woods, mia saw a pear tree. she wanted to pick a pear, but they were too high. so, mia's dad said, "i will raise you up." he lifted mia so she could reach the pears. mia picked a big, juicy pear and smiled. later, they had a picnic under the pear tree. mia shared her pear with her mom and dad. they all enjoyed the sweet fruit. mia was happy she could pick the pear, and her adventure in the woods was a success.

one day, a grumpy cat named tom went for a walk. the sun was shining and the sky was blue. tom did not like the happy day. he wanted to keep being grumpy. tom met a dog named max. max was happy and wanted to play. tom did not want to play. he wanted to keep being grumpy. max tried to make tom happy, but tom did not want to be happy. at the end of the day, tom went home. he was still grumpy. but max did not give up. every day, max tried to make tom happy. one day, tom smiled. he was not grumpy anymore. tom and max played together and were friends.

once upon a time, there was a silly duck named ducky. ducky loved to walk to the beach every day. he liked to look at the surf and watch the waves. one day, while ducky was walking, he saw a big surf. he thought it would be fun to play in the water. ducky jumped into the surf and splashed around. but then, the surf got bigger and bigger. ducky got scared and tried to walk back to the beach. the big surf was too strong, and ducky could not walk back. he was not able to get back to the beach, and the big surf took him away.

once upon a time, there was a little dinosaur. he loved to play in the rain. one day, it rained a lot and he got very wet. he jumped in the puddles and had so much fun. the little dinosaur wanted to go home. but he did not know how to get there. he was lost and felt sad. he tried to find his way back, but he could not manage it. then, he saw his mom and dad. they came to help him. they were so happy to find their little dinosaur. they all went home together. the little dinosaur was not lost anymore. he was safe and warm with his family.

one day, a little boy named tim was eager to finish his big puzzle. the puzzle had many pieces and it was a pretty sight when it was done. tim loved to look at it. while tim was putting the last piece, his little sister, sue, came running into the room. she bumped into the table and the puzzle fell down. tim was sad, and sue said sorry. tim was upset, but he knew his sister didn't mean to do it. he learned that it was important to forgive. so, tim and sue worked together to fix the puzzle again. this time, it was an even better sight.

one day, a little girl named lily found a talking carpet. the carpet could fly. lily was very happy. she said, "what is your name?" the carpet said, "my name is warmy." lily and warmy went on a fun trip. they flew up in the sky. they saw birds and trees. the sun was warm. lily said, "i like flying with you, warmy." warmy said, "i like flying with you too, lily." when they came back home, lily's mom saw the carpet. she said, "wow, a talking carpet! what is its name?" lily said, "his name is warmy." her mom said, "warmy is a good name." they all had a warm hug.

one day, a boy named tim went to play near a pool. he saw a small bottle with a label that said "shrink". tim was careless and did not think before he opened the bottle. as he opened the bottle, he started to shrink. he became smaller and smaller. tim called out to his friend, sam, who was near the pool. "help, sam! i am getting tiny!" sam saw tim and was scared. sam tried to help tim, but it was too late. tim was so small that he fell into the pool. the water was too deep for tiny tim. he could not swim and sadly, he did not make it out of the pool.

once upon a time, there was a big red ball. the ball liked to play with a little girl named sue. sue would kick the ball, and the ball would roll far away. sue and the ball had lots of fun. one day, sue kicked the ball too hard. it went into the kitchen and hit a sink. the sink was full of water. the ball fell into the water and got all wet. it was a spoiled ball now. sue was sad, but she knew how to fix it. she took the wet ball outside to dry in the sun. the ball was happy to gain its dryness back. sue and the ball played together again, and they were both very happy.

once upon a time, there was a red turkey. the turkey liked to jump all day. one day, the turkey went to the park to jump with his friends. at the park, the turkey met a little boy. the boy said, "hi, turkey! do you want to jump with me?" the turkey nodded his head and said, "yes, i want to jump with you!" the boy and the turkey jumped and played all day. they had lots of fun. when the sun went down, the boy said, "bye, turkey! i had fun jumping with you!" the turkey said, "bye! i had fun too!" and they both went home, happy and tired from their fun day at the park.

one day, a little dog named max went for a walk with his friend, a big cat named lily. they walked into a smelly fog. max and lily could not see very well. they were a little scared. max said, "lily, let's choose the right way to go home." lily said, "okay, max. let's go left." they walked and walked. the fog was still smelly and they could not see their home. finally, the fog went away. max and lily saw their home. they were very happy. they went inside and had a snack. they were not scared anymore.

once upon a time, there was a big cliff near a small town. on top of the cliff, there was a little bird named tim. tim was ready to learn how to fly. one sunny day, tim's mom said, "tim, it's time to enjoy flying!" tim was scared, but his mom said, "don't worry, i'll be with you." so, tim and his mom jumped off the cliff and started to fly. as they flew, tim began to enjoy the feeling of the wind in his wings. he said, "mom, i love flying!" his mom smiled and said, "i knew you would!" and they flew happily together in the sky.

once upon a time, there was a wealthy lady. she had a big house with many cupboards. she liked to fill her cupboards with good things. one day, a little boy came to her house. he was hungry and tired. the wealthy lady wanted to help him. she opened her cupboard and took out some food. she offered him a big plate of yummy treats. the little boy was happy and said thank you. he ate the food and felt better. the wealthy lady was glad she could help. from that day on, they became good friends.

once upon a time, there was a gentle dog named spot. spot loved to jog in the park every day. he liked to feel the sun on his face and the wind in his fur. one day, while spot was jogging, he heard a song. it was a happy song, sung by a little bird. spot stopped jogging and listened to the bird's song. the song made spot feel happy too. spot wanted to be friends with the bird. so, he gently wagged his tail and smiled. the bird saw spot and smiled back. from that day on, spot and the bird were best friends. they jogged and sang together in the park every day.

once upon a time, there was a lovely cat. the cat liked to play with a ball. the cat would take turns with his friend, the dog. they had so much fun playing with the ball. one day, the cat and the dog went to play near a big road. they took turns with the ball. the cat did not want to yield his turn. he wanted to play more and more. the cat did not see the car coming. the car did not stop. the cat was hit by the car. the dog was sad. they could not play together anymore. the end.

once upon a time, there was a large bird named tim. tim loved to whistle all day long. one day, tim found some clay near his tree. he thought it was fun to play with. tim had an idea. he decided to make a big surprise for his friends. he used the clay to make toys for them. tim whistled a happy song while he worked on his surprise. the next day, tim showed his friends the clay toys. they were so happy and excited! they played with the toys all day long. tim's friends loved the surprise and thanked him for being such a good friend.

once upon a time, there was a noisy dog named spot. he liked to twist and jump when he played. spot had a red velvet ball that he loved very much. one day, spot lost his velvet ball in the park. he looked everywhere for it. he was very sad. spot twisted and turned, but he could not find his ball. then, a kind girl found the ball and gave it back to spot. he was so happy! spot twisted and jumped with joy. from that day on, spot and the girl played together with the red velvet ball in the park.

once there was a caterpillar. he was very persistent and kept trying no matter what. one day, he found a delicious apple. he kept eating and eating, until he ate the whole thing! but then he started to feel sleepy. he looked around for a place to sleep and he found a flower. he kept crawling until he was in the middle of the flower. then he curled up and fell asleep. he kept sleeping for a very long time, until he woke up feeling different. he had become a butterfly! he kept flapping his wings until he reached the sky and flew away.

one day, a big human named tom went to the park. it was a sunny day, and the grass was dry. tom liked to play with his ball in the park. he saw a little dog named spot. spot liked to play too. tom said, "hi spot! do you want to play with my ball?" spot wagged his tail and barked. they played catch with the ball. tom threw the ball and spot ran to get it. they had a lot of fun. after playing, tom and spot were tired. they sat under a big tree. tom gave spot some water to drink. they both smiled and were happy. they had a fun day at the park together.

once upon a time, in a tall house, there lived a boy named tom. tom was a good boy, but he did not like to clean his room. one day, his mom told him, "tom, you need to remove all the toys from your room this week." tom did not want to do it. he waited and waited to clean his room. he played with his toys all week. his mom was not happy with him. on the last day of the week, tom's mom said, "tom, if you don't remove your toys, i will take them away." tom still did not clean his room. his mom came in and took all his toys away. tom was sad that he did not listen to his mom.

one day, a little cat saw a big tree. the cat wanted to climb the tree. but the tree was too tall. the cat saw a ladder near the tree. the cat was happy. the cat climbed the ladder to go up the tree. the cat realized it was fun to be in the tree. the cat saw many things from the tree. the cat saw a big dog, a small bird, and a red ball. soon, it was time for the cat to go down. the cat was grateful for the ladder. the cat climbed down the ladder and went home. the cat told all its friends about the fun tree and the helpful ladder.

once upon a time, there was a cool train. the train loved to go fast on the tracks. one day, the train met a little boy named tim. "hi, train!" tim said. "do you want to play with me?" "yes, i want to play!" the train replied. tim and the train went to play near a big tree. tim had a toy bucket with him. he poured water from the bucket onto the train to make it clean and shiny. they played all day long and became best friends. and they lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. he loved to go to the store with his mom. one day, they went to a new store. it was not the original store they always went to. at the new store, tim saw a big box. he wanted to open it. he said, "mom, can i open the box?" his mom said, "yes, but be careful." tim tried to open the box, but it was hard. he did struggle a lot. then, something unexpected happened. the box opened, and a big, colorful ball came out. it was a fun surprise! tim and his mom laughed and played with the ball. they liked the new store after all.

once upon a time, there was a new, small box. inside the box, there was a peanut. the peanut was very small too. it fit just right in the box. one day, a bird saw the box. the bird was hungry. it wanted to eat the peanut. so, the bird took the box and flew away. the bird opened the box to eat the peanut. but, the peanut was not there! the peanut was gone. the bird was sad and hungry. the end.

once upon a time, there were two best friends, lucy and jim. every day, they would borrow the same cup of tea. one day, lucy became jealous. she wanted to keep the tea all to herself, so she yelled at jim, "i won't let you borrow the tea!" jim, who was sad and hurt replied back, "why won't you let me borrow the tea? we always share it!" lucy felt embarrassed and angry, so she stomped away without saying a word. jim became very upset. now he was all alone, without a chance to borrow lucy's tea. without the tea, he felt lonely and sad. the end.

one day, a little boy named tim and his dog, spot, went to the park. tim wanted to play catch, but spot kept running away. tim felt frustrated. he wanted spot to trust him and play together. tim had an idea. he found a big stick and threw it far away. spot ran to get the stick and brought it back to tim. tim gave spot a big hug and said, "good job, spot! i knew you could do it!" from that day on, tim and spot played catch every day. they trusted each other and became the best of friends. and whenever they finished playing, they would always share a big, happy hug.

once upon a time, there was a little bird named tweet. tweet loved to sing. every day, tweet would sing happy songs. tweet had many friends who liked to listen to her sing. one day, tweet met a big, fast car. the car went zoom! tweet liked the car and wanted to be friends. tweet tried to sing to the car, but the car could not hear her. the car was deaf. tweet did not give up. she sang louder and louder, and she flew near the car. the car heard tweet's song and slowed down. they became good friends. tweet and the car would play together every day, and tweet would sing her happy songs.

once upon a time, there was a noisy bird named bob. bob liked to dive into the sky and sing loud songs. he lived in a big tree with his friends. one day, bob saw a soft pillow on the ground. he thought it would be fun to dive into it. so, he flew up high and dove right into the pillow. it was so soft and fluffy that he bounced right back into the air. bob loved the pillow so much that he showed it to his friends. they all took turns diving into the pillow and laughing. they had so much fun playing with the pillow that they forgot how noisy they were. and they all lived happily ever after.

one day, there was a big tough earthquake. bill and sue were playing in their backyard. suddenly, bill felt the ground shaking. he shouted, "sue, there's an earthquake!" sue looked up and saw the sun shining brightly in the sky. she said, "look, the sun is still shining." bill replied, "yes, the sun is still shining even when the ground shakes." they both hugged each other, feeling safe even in the middle of a tough earthquake. they knew the sun would always shine.

one day, a girl named lily found a big, dirty mug. she thought, "i will polish this mug and make it nice and shiny." so, lily got a cloth and began to polish the mug. as she polished, she heard a loud sound from inside the mug. "hello!" said a voice. lily was very surprised. she looked inside the mug and saw a tiny frog. the frog said, "thank you for making my home clean!" lily and the frog became good friends. they played all day and had lots of fun. and from that day on, lily always made sure to polish her new friend's mug home.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim loved to play with his football. every day, he would take it to the park and play with his friends. they would kick the ball, laugh, and have lots of fun. one day, tim saw a disgusting bug on his football. it was big and slimy. tim did not like bugs. he was scared and started to weep. his friends saw him crying and came to help. tim's best friend, sarah, saw the bug and gently picked it up. she moved it far away from the football. tim stopped weeping and smiled at sarah. they all went back to playing with the football, happy and safe.

once upon a time, there was a wealthy man named tom. tom had a big house and many toys. he liked to play all day. one sunny day, tom went outside to play. he saw a big ball near his house. tom wanted to kick the ball. he raised his knee and kicked it very hard. the ball flew high into the sky. the ball came down and landed near a little girl. she was happy to see the ball. tom and the little girl played with the ball all day. they had lots of fun and became good friends.

one day, a blue cat went for a jog in the park. the cat liked to jog and play with other cats. the sun was bright and the sky was blue. the blue cat saw a friend, a brown dog. the brown dog gave the blue cat a wink. the blue cat winked back. they were happy to see each other. the blue cat and the brown dog played together all day. they ran and jumped and had fun. when the sun went down, they said goodbye and went home. they knew they would play together again soon.

one day, a lively bunny named bob wanted to go to the park. he hopped and hopped until he saw his friend, a turtle named tim. tim was slow, but he was very nice. "hi, tim!" said bob. "do you want to go to the park with me?" "yes, bob!" said tim. "let's go!" at the park, they saw a big salad on a table. the salad had green leaves, red tomatoes, and yellow corn. bob and tim were hungry, so they ate the salad together. they were happy and full. after eating, they played in the sun. they ran, jumped, and laughed. it was a fun day for bob and tim at the park.

one day, a boy named tim wanted to buy a spade. he wanted to dig in his yard and make a big hole. tim went to the store with his mom to get the spade. at the store, tim saw many spades. but there was only one he liked. it was red and shiny. tim took the spade and went to his mom. but then, he felt dizzy. tim sat down and his mom gave him some water. the dizziness went away. tim and his mom bought the spade and went home. tim started to dig his hole. he was very happy. the dizziness did not come back. tim played with his spade all day long.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim was a very hungry boy. one day, he went out to play wearing his favorite pants. while playing, tim saw a big tree. he thought, "i want to hug the tree!" so, he ran to the tree and gave it a big hug. but, his pants got stuck on a branch. tim tried to get his pants free, but they would not come off. he started to cry. he was still very hungry and now he could not play or find food. no one heard tim's cries for help. he stayed stuck in the tree, hungry and sad. and that is how the story ends, with tim stuck and his favorite pants torn.

one day, a boy named tim found a small cell. he was troubled because he did not know what to do with it. he decided to tell his friend, sue, about the cell. tim went to sue's house and said, "sue, i have a cell, but i am troubled. what should i do with it?" sue thought for a moment and said, "let's ask my mom." sue's mom was busy, so she could not help them. tim and sue went to play with the cell. they threw it up in the air and tried to catch it. but then, the cell fell on a rock and broke. tim and sue were sad because they could not play with the cell anymore.

one sunny day, a little girl named lily went for a walk. she saw a big egg laying in the soft grass. she picked it up and carried it with her. as she walked, she met her friend tom. "look!" she said, "i found an egg!" tom was excited too. they decided to take the egg on a march. they marched with the egg through the park, singing a happy song. the egg felt light in their hands as they took turns carrying it. at the end of the day, they put the egg back in the grass where lily found it. they said goodnight to the egg and went home. they couldn't wait to see if the egg would hatch the next day.

one day, a young boy named tim went to the park. he saw a big wreck on the ground. he realized it was his friend's toy car. tim was sad for his friend. he looked around and saw his friend, max, sitting under a tree. tim went to max and said, "i found your toy car. it is a wreck now." max looked at the wreck and said, "oh no! i loved that toy car." just then, a big wind came and blew the wreck away. tim and max looked at each other and laughed. they didn't know the wind could do that. they were happy to see the wreck go away.

one day, a big cat and a little dog went to play. they ran to the green grass. the cat was fast, and the dog was alert. they had so much fun. the cat said, "let's play a game. i will run, and you try to catch me." the dog said, "okay, but if i catch you, you must pay me with a treat." the cat agreed, and they started the game. the cat ran fast, but the dog was alert. he watched the cat closely. soon, the dog caught the cat. the cat was happy and said, "good job, little dog! now, i will pay you with a treat." the dog was happy, and they played more games on the green grass.

once, there was a boy named tim. tim liked to act in plays at school. one day, his teach asked him to be in a new play. tim was very happy. the play was not fun. the play was dull. tim did not like to act in the dull play. but, he did not want to make his teach sad. so, tim tried to make the play fun. tim made funny faces and did silly things. the other kids laughed. the teach saw this and smiled. tim made the dull play fun for everyone. the teach was proud of tim.

one day, a boy named tim was ready to play. he put on his jacket with a zipper. he liked the sound of the zipper going up and down. it made him smile. tim went outside with his toy car. he saw a big hill. he wanted to record how fast his car could go down the hill. he got his mom's phone to record it. tim put the car at the top of the hill. he let go of the car and it went down fast. he was happy to see the car go so fast. tim showed his mom the video, and they both laughed.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tom. tom was a stubborn boy who loved to go on vacation with his family. one day, they went to the beach for their vacation. at the beach, tom saw a big, green turtle. the turtle had a name too. its name was tim. tom and tim played in the sand and swam in the water all day long. they had so much fun together. but then, something unexpected happened. tim the turtle spoke! he said, "i am not a real turtle, tom. i am a magical turtle!" tom was so surprised. from that day on, tom and tim the magical turtle went on many fun vacations together.

once upon a time, in a small town, there was a lot of mist. it was hard to see. a girl named lily was walking to her friend's house. she felt happy and comfortable in her warm coat. on the way, lily saw two paths. she had to choose which one to take. one path was short and the other was long. she thought the short path would be faster, so she chose it. as lily walked, the mist began to go away. she saw her friend's house and felt happy. they played together all day. lily knew she made a good choice. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a noisy bird named bob. bob liked to sing all day long. one day, bob flew into a room and saw a bulb. the bulb was shiny and bright. bob wanted to show the bulb to his friend, cat. he picked up the bulb with his beak and flew to cat's house. but on the way, bob lost the bulb. it fell from the sky and landed in a big tree. bob was sad and said to cat, "i lost the bulb i wanted to show you." cat said, "don't worry, bob. let's look for it together." they searched and found the bulb in the tree. bob and cat were happy and they played together all day.

one day, a little red train was going down the rail. the train had a big job to do. it needed to take food to the town on the other side of the hill. as the train went up the hill, it met an angry bird. the bird was mad because it could not find its nest. the train wanted to help the bird, but it needed to finish its job first. the train went fast down the rail and got the food to the town. then, it went back to help the angry bird. they looked and looked, and they found the nest. the bird was happy, and the train went back to its rail, feeling good about helping a friend.

once upon a time there was a stupid bear. the bear was very lazy and never wanted to do anything, which made him even more stupid. one day, the bear saw a spear on the ground, and he thought it was a good idea to use it. he held it in his hands, and wiggled it around trying to figure out what it did. he used it to try and poke the tree, but the spear just bounced right back. he got so frustrated that he threw the spear far away and it stuck in the dirt. luckily, he had not made a big mistake. from then on, the bear was a bit more careful with what he used.

once upon a time, in a big city, there was a humble boy named tom. he loved to ride the subway with his mom. they would go on fun trips to the park and the zoo. one day, while on the subway, tom saw two big boys fight. they were loud and scary. tom felt sad and wanted them to stop. he knew fighting was not nice. so, tom walked up to the boys and said, "please, no more fight. let's be friends." the boys stopped and looked at tom. they felt bad and said sorry. from that day on, they all became good friends and had fun riding the subway together.

once upon a time, there was a honest sausage. the sausage was stuck in a tree, and was too far away for the sausage to get down. but then, one day, a brave rescue man came. he had a ladder and a big net. the rescue man climbed to the top and put the net around the sausage. he carefully lifted it down to the ground. everyone was so happy that the honest sausage was rescued! the end.

once upon a time, there was an old judge who lived in a small house. the judge was very wise and kind. he had a big chair where he would sit and make choices for the people in the town. one day, a little bird came to the judge's house. the bird wanted to make a nest in the judge's big chair. the judge did not want to disturb the bird, so he let the bird stay. the bird and the judge became good friends. the bird would sing songs for the judge, and the judge would smile and clap. they were happy together, and the people in the town loved the old judge and his little bird friend even more.

one day, a ball and a rock were by a deep pond. the ball said, "i bet i can roll faster than you!" the rock said, "no way! i am strong and fast!" they decided to have a race to see who could roll to the pond first. they started to roll down the hill. the ball was very fast and the rock was very slow. as they got closer to the pond, the ball started to worry. "oh no, i don't want to fall into the deep pond!" but it was too late. the ball rolled into the pond and sank to the bottom. the rock stopped just in time and won the race. but the ball was lost in the deep pond forever.

once upon a time, there was a fragile bunny named bobo. bobo loved to eat carrots. one day, he found a big carrot in the garden. bobo tried to eat the carrot, but it was too hard. he started to complain. "this carrot is not good," said bobo. he felt sad because he could not eat his favorite food. then, bobo's friend, a bird named chirpy, came to help. chirpy told bobo to wait and flew away. chirpy came back with a soft carrot for bobo. bobo was happy and said thank you to chirpy. they both ate the carrot together and played in the garden.

one day, a kind cat went for a walk. the cat liked to hear stories from her friends. on her walk, she met a big dog. the dog was sad. the cat wanted to help the dog feel better. the cat told the dog a funny story. in the story, a little mouse made a big sneeze. the sneeze was so big that it blew all the leaves off a tree. the dog laughed and felt better. they became friends. the moral of the story is to be kind to others. when you are kind, you can make friends and help them feel better. and sometimes, a big sneeze can make you laugh.

once upon a time, in a lovely little house, there was a tiny mouse. the mouse had a friend, a big cat. they liked to play together. one day, the mouse said to the cat, "can i borrow your ball to play with?" the cat said, "yes, you can borrow my ball. let's play together!" they played all day with the ball. the mouse and the cat were very happy. they had lots of fun together. and they shared many more toys in their lovely little house.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. he had a favorite vest that he loved to wear. it was a fair day outside, so tim wanted to go play. tim's mom told him to be careful with his vest. she said, "don't let it get dirty, or it will be hard to clean." tim promised to be careful and went outside to play. while playing, tim saw a big mud puddle. he remembered his mom's words and stayed away from it. he played with his friends and they spread a big blanket on the grass for a picnic. tim was very happy that he kept his vest clean and had a fun day outside.

once upon a time, there was a quiet parrot. the parrot lived in a big tree. the tree was in a nice park. one day, a little girl came to the park. she saw the quiet parrot. the girl said, "hello, parrot!" the parrot said, "hello!" back to the girl. they liked each other. the girl asked the parrot, "do you want to sit with me?" the parrot said, "yes!" so, they sat on a bench. they talked and laughed. they were happy friends.

once upon a time, there was a regular cat named tom. tom liked to play and run around. one day, tom wanted to call his friend, a dog named max, to play. when max came to play, they saw a big box. they did not know what was in the box. they thought it was a surprise. they were very excited to see what was inside. tom and max opened the box. the surprise was not what they thought. it was a big cake! the cake was for tom's birthday. tom had forgotten about his birthday. they laughed and ate the cake together. the day was not regular anymore, it was a very special day.

one day, a boy named tim went to play in the park. he saw a big ball near the goal. he wanted to kick the ball and make a score. he thought he would be a mighty kicker. tim asked his friend sam to help him. sam was good at playing with the ball. they both kicked the ball many times. they were having so much fun. but then, a big dog came. the dog wanted to play too. it took the ball and ran away. tim and sam were sad. they could not play with the ball anymore. the dog was too fast for them. they went home with no score and felt bad.

once upon a time, there was a pretty girl named lily. she loved to play outside in the mud. one day, she decided to organize her mud into fun shapes. as she was playing, a little bird came to her. the bird said, "can i help you organize the mud?" lily was happy and said, "yes, let's make fun shapes together!" they were having so much fun making shapes, when suddenly, the mud started to move! the mud shapes turned into little mud friends who could talk and play. lily, the bird, and the mud friends played together all day long.

once upon a time, in a quiet little town, there was a girl named lily. she loved to take photos of everything she saw. one day, she went to the park with her camera. in the park, she saw a big tree with pretty flowers. lily took a photo of the tree. then, she saw a cute dog playing with a ball. she took a photo of the dog too. lily was very happy with her photos. after the park, lily went home to finish her photo album. she put the photo of the tree and the photo of the dog inside. when she was done, she showed her mom and dad. they all smiled and were very proud of lily's beautiful photos.

once upon a time, there was a yellow train. the train would go to the station every day. the train liked to repeat its trip. it made the train happy. one day, the yellow train went to the station like always. but something was different. the station was full of big balloons. the train was surprised. it did not know what to do. the yellow train decided to keep going. it went past the station. the train found a new place with more friends. it was a big party! the yellow train was happy and did not repeat its trip that day.

one day, a little girl named amy went to the shop with her mom. amy was a gifted girl who loved to learn new words. she saw a big dog outside the shop. the dog let out a big yawn. amy asked her mom, "mom, why did the dog yawn?" her mom said, "the dog is tired, amy." amy and her mom went into the shop. they bought a toy for amy's friend. as they left, the dog yawned again. amy smiled and said, "bye, tired dog!"

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she lived in a small house with her old grandma. lily loved to play with her toys on the floor every day. one day, lily found a big puzzle on the floor. she was very excited to solve it. she tried to put the pieces together, but it was hard. lily asked her old grandma for help. together, lily and her old grandma worked to solve the puzzle. they laughed and had fun. at last, they finished the puzzle on the floor. lily was very happy, and her old grandma was proud of her. they hugged and continued to play on the floor all day.

one day, tom and sam wanted to build a cool building. they went to the park with their toy blocks. tom said, "let's make the best building ever!" tom and sam started to build. they put one block on top of the other. the building got taller and taller. sam said, "wow, our building is so cool!" soon, their friends came to see the building. they all clapped and cheered. tom and sam felt very happy. they had built a cool building together.

one day, a little otter was playing near the water. he was impatient and wanted to find a new toy. he looked and looked, but he could not find one. this made the otter very sad. then, the otter saw a broken boat. he thought, "i can restore this boat and make it my new toy!" so, the otter started to fix the boat. he worked and worked, but it was hard. the otter did not give up. finally, the otter fixed the boat. he was so happy! now, he had a new toy to play with. the impatient otter learned that with hard work, he could make things better. and they all played together by the water.

once upon a time, there was a big, dull rock. the rock lived in a small park. every day, the rock sat there and did not move. it was not fun to play with. one day, a little girl came to the park. she saw the big, dull rock and said, "hello, rock! i will make you fun!" the little girl started to work. she painted the rock with bright colors. she put a big smile on the rock's face. now, the rock was not dull anymore. it was a happy rock. the rock said, "thank you, little girl! welcome to my park!" the little girl smiled and played with the rock. they became best friends.

emma was feeling happy. she went to the roof of her house. she saw some birds wearing colourful feathers. she wanted to wear feathers too! so her mum and dad found some colourful feathers for emma. she was very excited and put them on quickly. she wore them around the roof like the birds. emma felt very happy wearing the feathers. she laughed and twirled around the roof. the birds were singing and clapping their wings. when it was time to go home, emma took off the feathers and kept them safe in a box. she was sad to leave but happy that she had had a wonderful time.

once upon a time, there was a big lake. near the lake lived a small, independent duck. the duck liked to swim in the lake all by itself. one day, a little frog saw the duck swimming. the frog hopped to the duck and said, "hi, duck! can i swim with you?" the duck thought for a moment and then answered, "yes, frog! you can swim with me." so, the duck and the frog swam together in the lake. they had lots of fun and became good friends. from that day on, the independent duck liked to swim with its new friend, the frog.

once upon a time, there was a fat cat named tom. tom liked to drive his little red car. he drove it all around the town, over the hills, and through the woods. one day, tom's car ran out of gas. he was sad and didn't know what to do. so, he walked to the gas store with a big can. he filled the can with gas and carried it back to his car. tom poured the gas into his car and it started to go again. he was very happy. he drove his little red car all around the town, over the hills, and through the woods. and tom and his car lived happily ever after.

one day, a big modern cat went to the store. this cat liked to steal things. he saw a bottle of wine. the cat wanted to take it. the store man saw the cat and said, "no, cat! you cannot steal the wine!" the cat was sad and left the store. the cat walked around and thought of a new plan. the cat put on a hat and went back to the store. the store man did not know it was the same cat. the cat said, "i want to buy this wine, please." the store man smiled and gave the cat the wine. the cat was happy and did not have to steal.

one day, a large dog named max went to play in the park. he saw a girl named lily. lily had a toy to measure things. max wanted to play with the toy too. "can i play with your toy, lily?" asked max. "yes, you can play with it, max," said lily. they played with the toy and measured how tall the trees were. then, something unexpected happened. a big wind came and blew the toy away. max and lily were sad. but, max had an idea. he jumped and caught the toy in his mouth. they were happy again and kept playing.

one day, a boy named tim went to class. he saw his friend, sam, and they sat down. the teacher, miss lee, started to talk. tim and sam were excited to learn. tim did not want to listen. he thought it was fun to be rude. so, he shouted, "i don't want to learn!" miss lee was sad, but she kept teaching the class. then, something unexpected happened. a big wind came and blew the class away. tim and sam were scared. they wished they had listened to miss lee. now, they were lost and could not find their way back to class.

one day, a boy named tom found a broken thing. it was a toy with a spring inside. the toy was sad because it could not jump anymore. tom wanted to fix the toy, so he took it home. tom's friend, sue, saw the broken thing and wanted it. they both said, "it's mine!" they could not agree. they were mad at each other. they pulled the toy from both ends to see who would get it. the toy with the spring inside broke into two parts. tom and sue both had half of the broken thing. but now, the toy could not be fixed at all. tom and sue were still mad, and the toy was sadder than before.

one day, a big dog named max went for a walk. he saw his friend, a small cat named lily. max was happy to see lily. lily had a dull toy in her mouth. max wanted to play with the toy too. max asked lily, "can i play with your toy?" lily nodded her head, and they played together. they played near a big tree. max heard a sound near his ear. it was a tiny bird. the tiny bird said, "i want to play too!" max and lily were surprised. they did not know that birds can talk. they let the tiny bird play with them. now, they all had fun together.

once upon a time, there was a little bunny named tim. tim was a scared bunny. he would tremble when he heard loud noises. one day, tim wanted to be brave. on this day, tim went for a walk in the woods. he saw big trees and pretty flowers. tim felt happy. but then, he heard a loud noise. tim started to tremble. he was scared. tim closed his eyes and took a deep breath. he wanted to be brave. when he opened his eyes, he saw it was just a bird. the bird said, "hi, tim!" tim felt brave and not scared anymore. he made a new friend that day.

once upon a time, there was a little train named tim. tim had a job to deliver toys to the kids in the town. tim loved to make the kids happy with the toys. one day, tim had to go through a dark tunnel to reach the town. the tunnel was very long and scary. but brave tim went through the tunnel to deliver the toys. when tim came out of the tunnel, he saw a poor little boy. the boy was sad because he did not have any toys. tim gave the boy a big toy car. the boy was very happy, and tim felt good. from that day, tim always made sure to deliver toys to every kid, even the poor ones.

one day, a little boy named tim went to the park with his mom. he saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. as he climbed, he found a shiny medal hanging on a branch. tim was very happy to find the medal. tim took the medal and showed it to his mom. she was happy too. they stared at the medal together, and it sparkled in the sun. tim wore the medal around his neck and felt very proud. later, tim and his mom went home. tim showed the medal to his dad and sister. they all stared at the medal and smiled. they were happy that tim found a special treasure at the park.

one day, a little girl named lily was very excited. her aunt was coming to visit. lily loved her aunt because she was fun and always played with her. when her aunt arrived, she said, "lily, let's go play outside!" lily jumped up and down, happy to play with her aunt. they played in the mud, making mud pies and getting dirty. after playing, lily's mom said, "you two are so dirty! time to wash up!" lily and her aunt went inside to wash their hands and faces. they splashed water and laughed. lily was happy her aunt came to visit, and they had a great day together.

once upon a time, in a land far away, there was a big orange cat. the cat loved to keep pastel rocks. one day, the cat met a small blue bird. the bird asked the cat, "can i see your pastel rocks?" the cat said, "yes, come to my house." at the house, the cat showed the bird all his pastel rocks. they were pink, blue, and green. the bird loved the pink one the most. the cat and the bird became good friends. they played with the pastel rocks every day. the orange cat was happy to have a friend who liked his rocks too. and they lived happily ever after.

one day, a little girl named sally went to the park. she loved to spin on the round thing. it was so much fun to go fast and feel dizzy. sally saw her friend tim at the park too. "hi tim! want to spin with me?" sally asked. tim said, "yes, i love to spin!" so, they both got on the round thing and spun very fast. they laughed and screamed. it was so loud. after spinning, sally felt sick. her mom took her to the doctor. the doctor was nice and gave her a sticker. sally felt better soon. she learned not to spin too fast next time.

one day, a little girl named lucy saw a bug on the ceiling. she was scared of the bug. she called her big brother tom to help. tom said, "don't worry, lucy. trust me, i will get the bug down." tom got a chair and climbed up. he tried to get the bug, but it was too high. lucy felt bitter because she was still scared. tom had an idea. he said, "let's get dad to help. he is taller and can reach the bug." dad came and saw the bug on the ceiling. he said, "i can help, lucy. trust me." dad got the bug down and lucy was happy. she thanked her brother and her dad. they all had a good day after that.

once upon a time there was a girl named maya. she was a tough cookie who loved to explore. today she was going on an adventure. she put on her bright pink blouse and skipped out the front door. maya was so excited to explore. she went down the road and spotted a friendly looking cat. she wanted to meet the cat and so she crouched down and said hello. the cat was friendly and the two of them played together for a while. they rolled around in the grass and chased each other's tails. after a while, maya waved goodbye and ventured back home. she was so happy to have met a new friend!

once upon a time, there was a wealthy worm named wally. wally lived under a big tree. he had many friends in the garden. one day, wally met a little bug named betty. betty was sad. she wanted to complete her home, but she needed help. wally said, "i can help you, betty." wally and betty worked together. they finished making her home. betty was happy. they became best friends and played together every day.

once there was a boy who wished he could play with his friends all day. he hated having to be patient at home. one day his wish came true, and he was playing outside with his friends. but it was not all fun and games. his friends started to argue and soon they were fighting. the boy did not know what to do. he asked the others to be patient, but they kept pushing and fighting. in the end, the boy was hurt and he had to go home. he learned that wishes can sometimes have bad endings, and he hates that.

once upon a time, there was a hedge in the garden. every day, a little rabbit would hop in and out of the hedge. one day, the rabbit was very upset because something had gone wrong. she hopped up to the hedge and started to reverse around it. the hedge was so big that the rabbit had to go round and round. finally, after a few times going round and round the hedge, the rabbit was not upset anymore! the hedge had helped the rabbit feel better. the end.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tom. tom liked to play outside. one day, the wind was strong. it blew tom's hat away. he was sad and said, "oh no, my hat is gone!" tom's mom saw him and asked, "why are you sad?" tom told his mom about his hat. she said, "don't worry, we can replace it with a new one." tom's mom took him to the store. at the store, tom saw a rare hat. it was red and had a big star on it. he said, "i want that one!" tom's mom bought the hat for him. tom was very happy. he wore his new hat and played outside again.

once upon a time, there was a friendly frog named fred. fred loved to jump all day long. he would jump from one big rock to another big rock. he was very happy. one day, fred saw a pretty napkin on the ground. it was red and white. fred thought it would be fun to jump on the napkin. so, he jumped very high and landed on the napkin. the napkin was soft and nice. but then, a big wind came. the wind blew the napkin up in the air with fred on it. fred was scared. he tried to jump off, but he could not. the wind took fred far away. he never saw his big rocks and his home again.

once upon a time, there was a girl named amy. she loved to design. one day, she made a pretty package. she felt happy but a little uncomfortable. she did not know why. amy gave the package to her mom. her mom was very happy. she opened the package. inside was a big, soft teddy bear. but, something unexpected happened. the teddy bear moved! the teddy bear talked to amy and her mom. they were very surprised. the teddy bear was nice and wanted to be their friend. amy, her mom, and the teddy bear became best friends. they played together every day.

once upon a time, there was a modest ant. the ant loved to crawl all day. one day, the ant found a watch on the ground. the ant crawled onto the watch. the watch was big and shiny. the ant liked the watch a lot. the ant wanted to show the watch to his friends. the ant tried to crawl back home with the watch. but the watch was too heavy. the ant got very tired. the ant could not move anymore. the ant stayed there with the watch, and sadly, the ant did not make it back home.

once upon a time, there was a big brown dog. the big dog loved to play in the park. one day, the big dog went to the park with his friend, a small red bird. at the park, they saw a man with a cup of coffee. the man was not looking, and he left his coffee on a bench. the big dog and the small bird wanted to help the man. the big dog had an idea. he found a big leaf and used it to cover the coffee. the small bird helped him. the man came back and saw what they did. he was very happy. the big dog and the small bird were proud of themselves. they played in the park all day long.

one day, a big ostrich named ollie was walking in the park. ollie was a serious ostrich who liked to keep his feathers clean. he saw a little girl named sarah playing with her ball. sarah's ball went near ollie, and she said, "hi, mr. ostrich! can you help me get my ball?" ollie nodded and used his long neck to pick up the ball. he gave it back to sarah. "thank you, mr. ostrich!" sarah said with a smile. "you are good at keeping things safe." ollie felt happy and not so serious anymore. from that day on, ollie and sarah became good friends and loved to play together in the park.

once upon a time, there was an ugly frog. he lived in a small pond. he had a big stomach. he liked to eat bugs. one day, a little bird came to the pond. the bird said, "what do you do here, frog?" the ugly frog said, "i eat bugs. my big stomach likes them." the little bird and the ugly frog became friends. they played together every day. they were very happy. the frog's big stomach did not feel ugly anymore.

once upon a time, there was a big castle. it was enormous! in the castle lived a kind king and queen. they had a little girl named lily. lily loved to play in the big castle. one day, lily met a talking frog. the frog said, "hello, lily! do you want to play with me?" lily thought for a moment and said, "yes! let's play together!" they played all day long in the big castle. at the end of the day, lily said, "thank you, frog, for playing with me. i had so much fun!" the frog said, "i had fun too, lily! let's play again soon!" and they became the best of friends in the enormous castle.

once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a little bird named bobby. bobby was a very confused bird. he did not know which way was east. one day, he decided to find the east. bobby asked his friend, the squirrel, to help him. but the squirrel refused. he was too busy collecting nuts. so, bobby asked his friend, the rabbit, to help him. but the rabbit also refused. he was too busy hopping around. finally, bobby met a wise old owl. the owl knew where the east was. he told bobby to follow the sun in the morning. bobby did what the owl said, and he found the east. he was not confused anymore.

one day, a big cat saw a hot oven. the oven had a yummy cake inside. the cat wanted the cake, but it was not his cake. he thought, "i will steal the cake." the cat took the cake from the hot oven. a little dog saw the cat. the dog said, "that is not your cake! you should not steal!" the cat did not listen. he ran away with the cake. the little dog chased the big cat. they ran and ran until the cat was too tired. the dog said, "stealing is bad. you should say sorry." the cat felt bad and said sorry. they took the cake back. the cat learned not to steal.

once upon a time, there was a creative girl named mia. she liked to draw and make things with her hands. mia had a friend named bob. bob was a computer. mia and bob played together every day. one day, mia and bob were playing outside. they saw a big, scary bug. the bug made mia scream. bob the computer was scared too. they both ran away from the bug. mia and bob went back inside the house. they felt safe and happy. they played and laughed together. mia drew a funny picture of the big, scary bug. now, they were not scared of the bug anymore.

once upon a time, a boy named tim had a little boat. he liked to sail it on the pond. one day, he found a gold coin in the sand. he was very happy. he showed it to his friend, sam. sam wanted the gold coin too. he said it was his original coin. tim did not want to give it to sam. they were both mad. they did not play together that day. the next day, tim and sam talked. they decided to share the gold coin. they took turns holding it. they sailed their boats and played together again. they were happy and stayed friends.

once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a smart deer. the deer had many friends. one day, a little bird came to the deer. the bird was very sad. the bird said, "help me, please! my friend is stuck in a tree. can you rescue him?" the smart deer said, "yes, i will help you." the deer and the bird went to the tree. they saw the bird's friend. the deer was very tall. it used its long neck to reach the bird's friend. the deer rescued the bird's friend. the birds were very happy. they all played together in the forest.

one day, a little girl named lily went for a walk. she saw a big tree and wanted to skip around it. as she skipped, she found a soft cloth on the ground. "oh, what a pretty cloth!" she said. lily picked up the cloth and saw her friend, tom, coming. tom was eating a sour apple. he made a funny face. "this apple is so sour!" he said. lily laughed at tom's funny face. lily showed tom the cloth. "look what i found!" she said. tom liked the cloth too. they decided to play a game. they took turns skipping and holding the cloth. they had lots of fun and played until the sun went down.

once upon a time, there was a famous cat named kitty. kitty loved to stretch in the warm sun. one day, kitty went to the kitchen to find some food. in the kitchen, kitty met a little mouse. the mouse said, "hi, kitty! can we be friends?" kitty thought about it and said, "okay, let's be friends." they played together in the kitchen. but then, kitty's tummy started to hurt. kitty ate something bad from the kitchen. kitty felt very sad and sick. the little mouse tried to help, but it was too late. kitty's bad tummy made her very sick, and she couldn't play anymore.

once upon a time, there was a big orange tree. it had many orange balls. a little boy named tim went to the tree. he wanted to pick the orange balls. tim liked to eat them. they were sweet and yummy. one day, tim saw a little switch on the tree. he did not know what it was. he thought it was a toy. tim pulled the switch. then, something funny happened. the orange tree began to dance! the orange balls jumped up and down. tim was very surprised. he laughed and danced with the tree. they had a fun time together. from that day on, tim and the orange tree were best friends.

once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big, modern bell. the bell was shiny and new. it was in the middle of the town for everyone to see. one day, a nice man came to the town. he wanted to show people how to sign with their hands. he thought it would be fun for everyone to learn. so, he stood by the bell and started signing. the people in the town saw the man signing by the bell. they thought it was interesting. they wanted to learn how to sign too. so, they all came to the bell and the man taught them. they had a great time learning and signing together.

one day, tom wanted to study. he sat at a small table with his book. he looked at the words and pictures. he tried to learn. then, a package came. tom was excited. he opened the package. inside was a big, red ball. tom wanted to play with the ball. tom played with the ball inside. he threw it up and down. but, the ball hit a cup. the cup fell and broke. tom was embarrassed. he said sorry to mom. now, tom will play with the ball outside.

once upon a time, there was a cheerful cow named betsy. betsy lived on a farm with her friends. she liked to eat grass and play in the sun. one day, betsy saw a little girl crying. the girl was lost and could not find her mom. betsy wanted to comfort the girl, so she walked over to her. betsy let the girl pet her soft fur. the girl stopped crying and smiled at betsy. they played together until the girl's mom found them. the mom thanked betsy for being a good friend. betsy was happy she could help. from that day on, betsy and the girl were best friends.

once upon a time, in a big tree, there was a raven. the raven liked to fly and play in the hot sun. the raven had many friends in the tree. they all liked to play together. one day, the raven did not behave. he took a friend's toy and did not give it back. the friend was sad. the other friends did not like how the raven did not behave. the raven saw his friends were sad. he knew he had to behave. he gave the toy back and said sorry. from that day on, the raven and his friends played happily in the hot sun, and the raven always behaved.

one day, a big red ball wanted to bounce high. it wanted to touch the sky. so, it bounced and bounced. it went up and up. the big red ball was so happy. then, the big red ball hit a roof. it got stuck there. the big red ball was very ashamed. it did not want to be on the roof. it wanted to be on the ground. a little girl saw the big red ball on the roof. she said, "don't be ashamed, big red ball. i will help you." the little girl got a long stick. she pushed the big red ball off the roof. the big red ball was so happy to be on the ground again. it bounced and bounced with joy.

once upon a time, there was a little dog named max. max loved to watch his mom cook in the busy kitchen. he would sit and wag his tail, hoping for a treat. one day, max saw a big piece of meat on the table. he wanted to eat it, but he knew he needed to wait. max watched as his mom cut the meat and put it in a big pot. max was a good dog and waited patiently. when the meat was cooked, his mom gave him a small piece. max was so happy! he loved the tasty meat and knew that being a good dog was worth the wait.

one day, a girl named sue wanted to write a letter to her friend, tim. she wrote with big, fun letters. sue thought her letter was brilliant. she wanted tim to see it right away. sue had an idea. she would use tape to stick the letter on tim's door. that way, he would find it when he came home. "this will be a fun surprise," sue said to her dog, spot. when sue and spot got to tim's house, they taped the letter on the door. but then, a big wind came and blew the letter away. sue and spot tried to catch it, but they couldn't. the letter was lost. sue and spot went home sad.

once, there was a man who wanted to test something. but he didn't know what to test. so he decided to test some popcorn. he popped the popcorn and put it in a bowl. he waited and waited, but nothing happened. he thought the popcorn was dead. so he threw it away. he was disappointed because he couldn't test the popcorn. but he was happy he did not try to eat the dead popcorn. the end.

one day, tom and sam were playing with cards. tom had a big, serious face. sam asked, "why so serious, tom?" tom said, "i want to add more cards to our game. i have a plan." sam was excited and wanted to know the plan too. tom whispered the plan to sam. they both smiled and started to add more cards. they knew it was going to be fun. later, mom came in the room. she saw the big card tower they made. she was happy and said, "wow! you added so many cards!" tom and sam laughed. they knew their plan worked. they had fun adding cards and making mom smile.

once upon a time, there was a humble bird. the bird had pretty wings. it liked to fly high in the sky. one day, while the bird was flying, a big cloud appeared. the cloud was close to the bird. the bird was scared and flew away fast. but then, something unexpected happened. the cloud changed its shape. it looked like a big, friendly bird too! the humble bird and the cloud became friends. they played in the sky together. and they were happy.

once upon a time, there was a little ant named andy. andy was a very persistent ant. every day, he would try to move a big leaf to his home. one day, andy tried and tried to move the leaf, but it was too heavy. he did not succeed. he felt sad, but he did not give up. he knew he had to keep trying if he wanted a good result. the next day, andy asked his friends to help him. they all worked together and pushed the big leaf. with andy's persistent help, they finally succeeded! they were so happy with the result, and andy learned that he could do anything if he kept trying.

once upon a time, there was a powerful car. this car was very fast and could go zoom, zoom, zoom! the car had a friend, a little boy named tim. one day, tim wanted to drive the car. but he needed something called a license. a license was a special paper that let people drive. tim was sad because he was too little to have a license. tim's mommy saw him feeling sad. she had an idea! she made a pretend license for tim. tim was so happy to receive his pretend license. now, tim could play and pretend to drive the powerful car all day long. and they lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, in a hot and sandy land, there was a little camel named cally. cally lived near an oasis, a place with water and trees. she loved to play there with her friends. one day, a fierce lion came to the oasis. he was very big and scary. the lion roared and demanded, "give me all your food!" cally and her friends were scared, but they wanted to save their oasis. cally had an idea. she told her friends to make a big, loud noise. they stomped their feet and yelled together. the lion was scared of the noise and ran away. cally and her friends saved the oasis and were very happy.
